# Shrink inventory: get below 8,423 lines without removing features (#105)

## Goal
After restructuring (#63) the repo grew from 8,423 to 9,386 lines (git archive + wc -l over bin, lib, claude, tests, docs, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, install.sh): source +473, prompts/skills +73, tests +658. The user wants a further shrink to ≤ 8,423 lines. User-facing features stay: work folders (`harness lane`, `-C`, guard), dashboard + `open-watch`/`/watch`, notify hook, gate short reads, Notes→wiki issues, review rules. Your list feeds the user's approval.

## Constraints
Read-only on the repo (primary checkout on main, 43fc5a7). Write only under `.harness/`. No commits.

## Steps
1. Per file line counts now (same method) and the biggest growth since db418dc (`git diff --stat db418dc..HEAD`).
2. Source candidates: dead code (functions with no caller, e.g. `last_ask_record`), duplicated helpers (path canonicalisation in gate vs lane, jq width code, quoting), branches no one reaches, over-long usage/help text, comments that restate code. For each: file:line, lines saved, risk.
3. Test candidates: duplicated setup that a shared helper could replace (tests/harness-lib.sh), assertions repeated across suites (e.g. gate cases covered both in gate.test.sh and gate-denied.list), tests of removed behaviour, very long golden blocks that could be shorter without losing what they prove. Keep tests that prove a reviewed bug fix (mutant/base-failing checks). For each: lines saved, what coverage is kept.
4. Prompts/skills/docs: duplicated rules between AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, conductor.md and skills (state each rule once).
5. Group into 2–4 PR-sized batches ordered by risk, with totals; show whether the sum reaches ≤ 8,423. If it cannot without removing a feature, say which feature would have to go and how much it would save.

## Done criteria
Report in Korean: per-batch table (item, file:line, lines saved, risk), total, whether the target is reachable. Full list in `.harness/shrink2-inventory.md`.

# Wiki index

Read this first. Open a page only when it is relevant. Schema and promotion rules: the Wiki section of `AGENTS.md`. `wiki`-label issues go stale fast: check `git log` for a fix before triaging one.

## Troubleshooting: ask completion and timeouts
- [ask --timeout is ms](troubleshooting/ask-timeout-is-milliseconds.md): `--timeout 1200` = 1.2s; defaults are role-aware (active, 2026-10-27)

## Troubleshooting: conductor
- [Conductor shell: one command](troubleshooting/conductor-shell-one-command.md): exactly one simple command: no `;`, `&&`, `|`, redirects (active, 2026-10-21)

## Troubleshooting: shell portability and tests
- [GNU stat -f](troubleshooting/gnu-stat-f.md): use `-nt`/`-ot` or `stat -c %Y` first (active, 2026-10-21)
- [bash signals and job control](troubleshooting/bash-signals-job-control.md): bg jobs ignore INT; `set -m` hands tty signals to children (active, 2026-10-27)
- [Tests inherit worker env](troubleshooting/tests-inherit-worker-env.md): suites run by a worker see `HARNESS_ROLE=worker`; unset it (active, 2026-10-27)
- [Half-assertion tests](troubleshooting/half-assertion-tests.md): `check [ a ] && [ b ]` asserts only a; prove fixes with a mutant; remove the primary source before a fallback test (active, 2026-11-03)
- [wiki-lint dangling sources](troubleshooting/wiki-lint-dangling-sources.md): lint checks only non-empty `sources`; grep the slug before deleting a suite or page (active, 2026-11-03)
- [No-edits brief skips report](troubleshooting/no-edits-brief-skips-report.md): say "no source edits (report still required)" or the implementer exits 3 (active, 2026-11-03)

## How-to

- [0002 Stop-hook completion](decisions/0002-completion-by-stop-hook-marker.md): pane marker; superseded by exit.json (superseded, 2026-11-02)
- [0003 Pane lifecycle](decisions/0003-pane-lifecycle-defaults.md): pane idle TTL and close rules; removed (superseded, 2026-11-02)
- [0004 Failure-only retros](decisions/0004-failure-only-batched-retros.md): removed in prune step 4 (superseded, 2026-11-02)

- [0006 Keep implementer pane](decisions/0006-keep-implementer-pane.md): implementer pane kept; no panes remain (superseded, 2026-11-02)
- [0007 Headless runner pilot](decisions/0007-headless-runner-pilot.md): `claude -p` detached; completion = exit file; `runner` key removed in step 3 (active, 2026-11-02)
- [0008 Worktree per ask](decisions/0008-worktree-per-ask.md): removed in prune step 4 (superseded, 2026-11-02)
- [0009 Headless implementer](decisions/0009-headless-implementer.md): headless implementer: pinned permissions, exit 2 on denials, auto-resume after non-zero exit, 90 min cap (active, 2026-11-02)
- [0010 Harness acts only in a checkout](decisions/0010-herdr-optional-gate-by-checkout.md): gate/resume key on .harness/asks (made by `harness init`); per-repo conductor agent; no HERDR_ENV switch; `harness wait`/`watch`; doctor and `--worktree` removed in step 4 (active, 2026-11-02)

- [0012 Gate shrink](decisions/0012-gate-shrink.md): gate kept and trimmed to observed use (552 → 513 lines); permissions-rules and native-subagent options rejected (active, 2026-11-03)
- [0013 Remove herdr](decisions/0013-remove-herdr.md): no herdr in code/gate/install; watch via `harness watch` in any terminal (active, 2026-11-13)
- [Per-issue work folders](how-to/work-folders.md): lane create/rm, -C parallel asks, lane_setup, risks (active, 2026-11-13)

content.content:
1	#!/bin/bash
2	# The body is one brace group: bash parses the whole file before running any of it, so a
3	# tool that rewrites this file in place cannot corrupt a run in progress (wiki: troubleshooting).
4	{
5	# harness — conductor-side wrapper for detached headless Claude workers (decision 0011).
6	#
7	#   harness ask    <agent> '<instruction>' [--timeout MS] [--keep]
8	#     default --timeout = the role's headless run cap (a background ask returns when the run ends):
9	#     implementer 5400000, analyst/reviewer 3600000
10	#   harness report <agent>
11	#   harness wait   <agent> [--timeout MS]   block until the run ends (0 done, 3 no ask/gone, 4 timeout); does not collect
12	#   harness watch  <agent> [-n N]   human terminal only: follow a live run, or the last N lines of a finished one
13	#   harness status
14	#   harness [-C DIR] <command> ...   run as if started in DIR (a work folder)
15	#   harness lane <issue#> [slug] [--type feat|fix|docs] | lane ls | lane rm <issue#|path> [--force]   per-issue work folders (git worktrees)
16	#   harness init [--no-agent] [--shared]   make this repo a harness checkout (.harness/asks, config, agent=conductor in .claude/settings.local.json; --shared: settings.json)
17	#   harness close  <agent> [--force]
18	#   harness metrics [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--json]   health numbers from progress.jsonl + the wiki
19	#   harness wiki-lint [DIR]   check docs/wiki format and limits (0 = pass)
20	#
21	# Exit codes for `ask`: 0 report printed · 1 usage/setup error
22	#                       2 the run was denied a tool call and wrote no report (re-ask with a changed brief)
23	#                       3 worker finished without a report
24	#                       4 run still going / unknown (a background ask returns when the run ends)
25	#                       5 verification failed (implementer's checks gave up, or the
26	#                         reviewer's last line is `VERDICT: FAIL`); the report is
27	#                         still printed on stdout. A reviewer report without a
28	#                         final VERDICT line counts as no valid report (3).
29	# `report` prints .harness/reports/<agent>.md with the same exit codes as `ask`
30	#   (0 · 3 no report/no VERDICT · 5 verification failed), plus 4 while the run is
31	#   still going. It never sends a prompt.
32	# Workers (HARNESS_ROLE=worker) may not ask: skills are user-global and would otherwise nest.
33	# .harness/ lives in the checkout root: `harness init` creates it; ask refuses without it
34	# and, run from a subdir of the checkout, continues at the root.
35	# Every ask is logged to .harness/log/ and .harness/progress.jsonl, and
36	# .harness/progress.md is regenerated (log errors only warn on stderr).
37	# Config: .harness/config.json (optional `headless_max_minutes`). `harness close` refuses (exit 4) a
38	#   running ask unless --force. Closes are logged to progress.jsonl.
39	# Output of `ask`: stdout = report on exit 0 and 5; diagnostics on stderr.
40	set -u
41	
42	# lib/ is sourced eagerly, here, inside the brace group: bash 3.2 reads a sourced file whole,
43	# so an in-place edit cannot corrupt the run (a lazily sourced file would lose that protection).
44	# The symlinked $0 is resolved by hand (no readlink -f on old macOS).
45	src=${BASH_SOURCE[0]}
46	while [ -L "$src" ]; do
47	  case $src in */*) d=$(CDPATH= cd -P "${src%/*}" && pwd) ;; *) d=$PWD ;; esac
48	  src=$(readlink "$src")
49	  case $src in /*) ;; *) src=$d/$src ;; esac
50	done
51	case $src in */*) d=${src%/*} ;; *) d=. ;; esac   # no dirname: PATH may be bare in hooks/tests
52	HARNESS_LIB=${HARNESS_LIB:-$(CDPATH= cd -P "$d/../lib" 2>/dev/null && pwd)}
53	# Explicit list, fixed order, no glob: a stray file in lib/ is never sourced. Definitions only.
54	for m in defaults root metrics headless dash lane openwatch; do
55	  . "$HARNESS_LIB/harness-$m.sh" 2>/dev/null || { echo "harness: cannot load lib/harness-$m.sh" >&2; exit 1; }
56	done
57	unset src d m
58	# end loader
59	
60	AGENTS=$HARNESS_ROLES
61	REPORT_DIR=".harness/reports"
62	LOG_DIR=".harness/log"
63	JSONL=".harness/progress.jsonl"
64	PROGRESS_MD=".harness/progress.md"
65	DEFAULT_TIMEOUT=$HARNESS_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
66	IMPLEMENTER_TIMEOUT=$HARNESS_IMPLEMENTER_TIMEOUT_MS
67	ASK_DIR=".harness/asks"
68	# parsed once by ask_parse_args (cmd_ask); ask_inner only reads them
69	ASK_TIMEOUT=$DEFAULT_TIMEOUT; ASK_TIMEOUT_SET=0; ASK_KEEP=0; ASK_BAD=0; ASK_NOLANE=0
70	
71	usage() {
72	  cat >&2 <<EOF
73	usage:
74	  harness ask    <agent> '<instruction>' [--timeout MS (default: implementer $IMPLEMENTER_TIMEOUT, others $DEFAULT_TIMEOUT)] [--keep]
75	  harness report <agent>
76	  harness wait   <agent> [--timeout MS]
77	  harness watch  <agent> [-n N]   (human terminal only)
78	  harness status
79	  harness [-C DIR] <command> ...
80	  harness lane   <issue#> [slug] [--type feat|fix|docs] | ls | rm <issue#|path> [--force]
81	  harness init   [--no-agent] [--shared]   (once per repo: makes it a harness checkout; ask refuses without it)
82	  harness close  <agent> [--force]
83	  harness wiki-lint [DIR]
84	  harness metrics [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--json]
85	agents: $AGENTS
86	EOF
87	  exit 1
88	}
89	
90	die() { echo "harness: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
91	
92	need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "$1 not found on PATH"; }
93	
94	valid_agent() {
95	  case " $AGENTS " in
96	    *" $1 "*) return 0 ;;
97	  esac
98	  die "unknown agent '$1' (expected one of: $AGENTS)"
99	}
100	
101	# fmt_ctx <tokens> — "137k", or "-" when unknown
102	fmt_ctx() {
103	  case "${1:-}" in
104	    ''|*[!0-9]*) echo - ;;
105	    *) echo "$(($1 / 1000))k" ;;
106	  esac
107	}
108	
109	# last_ask_record <agent> [--where JQ] [--field JQ]
110	# The newest progress line of <agent> among the last 200 non-close lines that has no ask_id
111	# (old rows: the removed --worktree asks logged `agent: <role>` plus an ask_id and must never
112	# stand in for a plain ask) and matches the extra jq condition --where. Prints --field (default: the compact line); nothing = unknown.
113	# --where/--field are jq source from the caller's own literals.
114	last_ask_record() {
115	  local agent=$1 where=true field=. prog
116	  shift
117	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
118	    case "$1" in
119	      --where) where=$2; shift 2 ;;
120	      --field) field=$2; shift 2 ;;
121	      *) return 2 ;;
122	    esac
123	  done
124	  prog="fromjson? | select(type == \"object\" and .agent == \$a and (.ask_id // \"\") == \"\") | select($where) | $field"
125	  grep -v '"event":"close"' "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 200 \
126	    | jq -R -r -c --arg a "$agent" "$prog" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1
127	}

131	git_head() { git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; }
132	# file_sum <file> — cksum "crc-size" of a file (portable), empty if unreadable
133	file_sum() { cksum < "$1" 2>/dev/null | awk '{ print $1 "-" $2 }'; }
134	num_or_null() { case "${1:-}" in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo null ;; *) echo "$1" ;; esac; }

136	# record_progress <agent> <text> <rc> <t0> <head_before> <stdout-file>
137	# Writes the log file + jsonl line, rotates, regenerates progress.md.
138	record_progress() {
139	  local agent=$1 text=$2 rc=$3 t0=$4 hb=$5 out=$6 cb=
140	  local report="$REPORT_DIR/$agent.md" vj=.harness/verify/implementer.json rmt
141	  local now ts stamp ha sess ca status="" summary="" verify="" logf n brief sha="" va="" hl='{}'
142	  now=$(date +%s)
143	  # a report older than this ask is a previous ask's (this one died before archiving it)
144	  if [ -f "$report" ]; then rmt=$(file_mtime "$report") && [ "$rmt" -ge "$t0" ] || report=/dev/null.none; fi
145	  ts=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
146	  stamp=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
147	  ha=$(git_head)
148	  # session and context come from the run's exit.json
149	  hl=$(hl_progress_obj "$agent" "$t0")
150	  sess=$(printf '%s' "$hl" | jq -r '.session // empty' 2>/dev/null)
151	  ca=$(printf '%s' "$hl" | jq -r '.ctx_after // empty' 2>/dev/null)
152	  cb=$(sed -n 's/^ctx_before=//p' "$ASK_DIR/$agent.run" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
153	  hl=$(printf '%s' "$hl" | jq -c 'del(.session, .ctx_after)' 2>/dev/null) || hl='{}'
154	  if [ -f "$report" ]; then
155	    status=$(sed -n 's/^status: *//p' "$report" | head -n 1)
156	    summary=$(sed -n 's/^# *//p' "$report" | head -n 1)
157	    sha=$(file_sum "$report")
158	  fi
159	  if [ "$agent" = implementer ]; then
160	    verify=$(jq -r '.status // empty' "$vj" 2>/dev/null)
161	    va=$(jq -r '.attempts // empty' "$vj" 2>/dev/null)
162	    grep -q '^verify: INTERRUPTED' "$out" 2>/dev/null && verify=interrupted
163	  fi
164	
165	  mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" || return 1
166	  logf="$LOG_DIR/$stamp-$agent.md"; n=1
167	  while [ -e "$logf" ]; do n=$((n + 1)); logf="$LOG_DIR/$stamp-$agent-$n.md"; done
168	  brief=$(printf '%s' "$text" | grep -o '\.harness/task-[A-Za-z0-9_.-]*\.md' | head -n 1)
169	  {
170	    printf '# %s ask %s (exit %s, %ss)\n\n## Instruction\n\n%s\n' "$agent" "$ts" "$rc" "$((now - t0))" "$text"
171	    if [ -n "$brief" ] && [ -f "$brief" ]; then
172	      printf '\n## Brief (%s)\n\n' "$brief"; cat "$brief"
173	    fi
174	    if [ -f "$report" ]; then
175	      printf '\n## Report\n\n'; cat "$report"
176	    else
177	      printf '\n## Screen / output (no report)\n\n'; cat "$out"
178	      if [ "$hl" != '{}' ]; then
179	        printf '\n## Run output (last 40 lines)\n\n'
180	        hl_view_tail "$agent" 40
181	      fi
182	    fi
183	    if [ -s "${ASK_ERR:-}" ]; then
184	      printf '\n## Errors\n\n'; cat "$ASK_ERR"
185	    fi
186	    if [ "$hl" != '{}' ]; then
187	      printf '\n## Run\n\n'
188	      printf '%s' "$hl" | jq -r '"result \(.result // "-"), turns \(.turns // "-"), cost $\(.cost_usd // "-"), stream \(.stream_log // "-")"' 2>/dev/null
189	    fi
190	  } > "$logf" || return 1
191	
192	  # rotate the jsonl first so the new line lands in the fresh file
193	  if [ -f "$JSONL" ] && [ "$(wc -c < "$JSONL" | tr -d ' ')" -gt "${HARNESS_JSONL_MAX:-1048576}" ]; then
194	    mv "$JSONL" "$JSONL.$stamp" && gzip -f "$JSONL.$stamp"
195	  fi
196	  jq -n -c --arg ts "$ts" --arg agent "$agent" --arg session "$sess" \
197	    --arg instr "$(printf '%s' "$text" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-160)" \
198	    --argjson exit "$rc" --arg verify "$verify" --argjson dur "$((now - t0))" \
199	    --arg hb "$hb" --arg ha "$ha" --argjson cb "$(num_or_null "$cb")" --argjson ca "$(num_or_null "$ca")" \
200	    --arg status "$status" --arg summary "$summary" --arg sha "$sha" --argjson va "$(num_or_null "$va")" \
201	    --argjson hl "$hl" --argjson nl "${ASK_NOLANE:-0}" '
202	    def nz: if . == "" then null else . end;
203	    {ts: $ts, agent: $agent, session: ($session | nz), instr: $instr, exit: $exit,
204	     verify: ($verify | nz), verify_attempts: $va, dur_s: $dur, head_before: ($hb | nz), head_after: ($ha | nz),
205	     ctx_before: $cb, ctx_after: $ca, status: ($status | nz), summary: ($summary | nz), report_sha: ($sha | nz)} + (if $nl == 1 then {no_lane: true} else {} end) + $hl' >> "$JSONL" || return 1
206	
207	  rotate_logs "$logf"
208	  write_progress_md
209	  return 0
210	}

212	# ask_parse_args <agent> <text> [opts...] — the one walk over an ask's options (called by cmd_ask
213	# after the agent and text checks). Sets ASK_TIMEOUT/KEEP.
214	# The instruction text is positional, so an option-looking word inside it is never an option. A bad option,
215	# --timeout value only sets ASK_BAD: ask_inner turns that into the usage
216	# error inside the logged subshell (exit 1 is recorded in progress).
217	ask_parse_args() {
218	  local agent=$1
219	  shift 2
220	  ASK_KEEP=0; ASK_BAD=0
221	  ASK_TIMEOUT=$DEFAULT_TIMEOUT; ASK_TIMEOUT_SET=0
222	  [ "$agent" != implementer ] || ASK_TIMEOUT=$IMPLEMENTER_TIMEOUT
223	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
224	    case "$1" in
225	      --timeout)
226	        case "${2:-}" in
227	          ''|*[!0-9]*|0) ASK_BAD=1; shift ;;     # missing/invalid value: usage (logged)
228	          *) ASK_TIMEOUT=$2; ASK_TIMEOUT_SET=1; shift 2 ;;
229	        esac ;;
230	      --keep) ASK_KEEP=1; shift ;;
231	      *) ASK_BAD=1; shift ;;
232	    esac
233	  done
234	}

236	# rotate_logs <current-log> — newest N logs kept, older than D days deleted; raw headless
237	# streams are gzipped once a day old and dropped with the logs
238	rotate_logs() {
239	  local f
240	  ls -1t "$LOG_DIR"/*.md 2>/dev/null | grep -vxF -- "$1" | tail -n +"${HARNESS_LOG_KEEP:-200}" \
241	    | while IFS= read -r f; do rm -f "$f"; done
242	  find "$LOG_DIR" -name '*.md' -mtime "+${HARNESS_LOG_DAYS:-14}" 2>/dev/null \
243	    | grep -vxF -- "$1" | while IFS= read -r f; do rm -f "$f"; done
244	  find "$LOG_DIR" -name '*.jsonl' -mtime +0 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r f; do gzip -f "$f" 2>/dev/null; done
245	  find "$LOG_DIR" \( -name '*.jsonl' -o -name '*.jsonl.gz' \) -mtime "+${HARNESS_LOG_DAYS:-14}" 2>/dev/null \
246	    | while IFS= read -r f; do rm -f "$f"; done
247	  return 0
248	}

250	# write_progress_md — regenerate .harness/progress.md (<= 60 lines)
251	write_progress_md() {
252	  local tmp="$PROGRESS_MD.tmp.$$" branch goal a f q line=""
253	  branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "-")
254	  goal="(unset)"
255	  if [ -s .harness/goal.md ]; then
256	    goal=$(tr '\n' ' ' < .harness/goal.md | sed 's/  */ /g; s/ $//' | cut -c1-400)
257	  fi
258	  {
259	    printf '# Progress — %s (%s)\n' "$(basename "$PWD")" "$branch"
260	    printf 'Goal: %s\n' "$goal"
261	    printf '## Recent asks (newest first, max 15)\n'
262	    grep -v '"event":"close"' "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 15 | jq -r -R 'fromjson? | "- \(.ts) \(.agent) \(if .late then "late report" else "exit \(.exit)" end) verify \(.verify // "-") \(.head_before // "")..\(.head_after // "") — \(.summary // "")"' 2>/dev/null \
263	      | awk '{ a[NR] = $0 } END { for (i = NR; i >= 1; i--) print a[i] }'
264	    q=$(grep '"event":"close"' "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 5 | jq -r -R 'fromjson? | "\(.ts) \(.role) (\(.reason // "?"))"' 2>/dev/null \
265	      | awk '{ a[NR] = $0 } END { for (i = NR; i >= 1; i--) printf "%s%s", (i == NR ? "" : "; "), a[i]; if (NR) print "" }')
266	    [ -z "$q" ] || printf 'Recent closes (max 5): %s\n' "$q"
267	    for f in $(ls -t .harness/reports/*.md 2>/dev/null); do
268	      q=$(awk '/^## Open questions/ { on = 1; next } /^## / { on = 0 } on && /^- / { if (tolower($0) !~ /^- *none *$/) print }' "$f" | head -n 10)
269	      if [ -n "$q" ]; then
270	        printf '## Open questions (from %s)\n%s\n' "$(basename "$f" .md)" "$q"
271	        break
272	      fi
273	    done
274	    printf '## Workers\n'
275	    for a in $AGENTS; do
276	      q=$(hl_status_line "$a" progress)
277	      if [ -z "$line" ]; then line=$q; else line="$line · $q"; fi
278	    done
279	    printf -- '- %s\n' "$line"
280	  } 2>/dev/null | head -n 60 > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$PROGRESS_MD"
281	}

301	# learned_has_evidence <text> — the bullet cites an ask-id, a commit (7-40 hex with a
302	# letter a-f and a digit, standalone), path/file.ext:line (path has a / or an extension),
303	# a .harness/ path or a .log file. `step:2`, `host:8080` and bare numbers do not count.
304	learned_has_evidence() {
305	  printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -Eq '(^|[^0-9])[0-9]{9,}-[0-9]+-[0-9]+|[A-Za-z0-9_.-]*/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]*:[0-9]+|[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,4}:[0-9]+|\.harness/|\.log([^A-Za-z]|$)' && return 0
306	  printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -Eo '(^|[^0-9A-Za-z])[0-9a-f]{7,40}($|[^0-9A-Za-z])' | grep '[0-9]' | grep -q '[a-f]' && return 0
307	  return 1
308	}

310	# queue_learned <agent> <report> — file each evidence-backed bullet of the report's
311	# optional `## Notes` section (legacy `## Learned` is also accepted) as a GitHub
312	# issue labelled `wiki` (title: first 70 chars; body: bullet + source line).
313	# Indented continuation lines are joined to their bullet. An open `wiki` issue
314	# with the same title is skipped. Bullets without evidence are dropped with a
315	# one-line stderr warning. Never fails the caller: no gh, a failing gh or no
316	# ask-id print one warning and continue.
317	queue_learned() {
318	  local agent=$1 report=$2 raw line kept="" n=0 dropped=0 askid date title body open made=0 skipped=0
319	  raw=$(awk '
320	    function flush() { if (cur != "") print cur; cur = "" }
321	    /^## (Learned|Notes)[ \t]*$/ { on = 1; next }
322	    on && (/^## / || /^VERDICT:/) { flush(); on = 0 }
323	    on && /^[ \t]*[-*] / { flush(); cur = $0; sub(/^[ \t]*[-*] +/, "- ", cur); next }
324	    on && cur != "" && /^[ \t]+[^ \t]/ { t = $0; sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", t); cur = cur " " t; next }
325	    on && /^[ \t]*$/ { flush() }
326	    END { flush() }
327	  ' "$report" 2>/dev/null) || return 0
328	  [ -n "$raw" ] || return 0
329	  while IFS= read -r line; do
330	    case "$line" in "- none"|"- None"|"- none."|"- -") continue ;; esac
331	    if learned_has_evidence "$line"; then
332	      n=$((n + 1))
333	      kept="$kept$line
334	"
335	    else
336	      dropped=$((dropped + 1))
337	    fi
338	  done <<EOF_LEARNED
339	$raw
340	EOF_LEARNED
341	  [ "$dropped" -eq 0 ] || echo "harness: wiki: dropped $dropped Notes bullet(s) without evidence (ask-id, commit, file:line or log)" >&2
342	  [ -n "$kept" ] || return 0
343	  askid=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$agent.current" 2>/dev/null)
344	  if [ -z "$askid" ]; then
345	    echo "harness: wiki: no ask-id for $agent; Notes bullets not filed" >&2
346	    return 0
347	  fi
348	  if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
349	    echo "harness: wiki: gh not found; Notes bullets not filed as issues" >&2
350	    return 0
351	  fi
352	  date=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
353	  open=$(gh issue list --label wiki --state open --limit 200 --json title --jq '.[].title' 2>/dev/null) || {
354	    echo "harness: wiki: gh issue list failed; Notes bullets not filed as issues" >&2
355	    return 0
356	  }
357	  while IFS= read -r line; do
358	    [ -n "$line" ] || continue
359	    line=${line#- }
360	    title=$(printf '%s' "$line" | cut -c1-70)
361	    if printf '%s\n' "$open" | grep -qxF -- "$title"; then
362	      skipped=$((skipped + 1))
363	      continue
364	    fi
365	    body="$line
366	
367	Source: $agent ask $askid, $date"
368	    if gh issue create --label wiki --title "$title" --body "$body" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
369	      made=$((made + 1))
370	      open="$open
371	$title"
372	    else
373	      echo "harness: wiki: gh issue create failed; remaining Notes bullets not filed" >&2
374	      break
375	    fi
376	  done <<EOF_KEPT
377	$kept
378	EOF_KEPT
379	  [ "$made" -eq 0 ] && [ "$skipped" -eq 0 ] && return 0
380	  echo "wiki: $made issue$([ "$made" -eq 1 ] || echo s) filed with label wiki ($skipped duplicate skipped)"
381	}

383	# finish_report <agent> <report> — print the report and exit with the
384	# verification-aware status (0 pass · 3 reviewer without VERDICT · 5 failed)
385	finish_report() {
386	  local agent=$1 report=$2 last vj st
387	  queue_learned "$agent" "$report"
388	  case "$agent" in
389	    implementer)
390	      vj=".harness/verify/implementer.json"
391	      st=$(jq -r '.status // empty' "$vj" 2>/dev/null)
392	      cat "$report"
393	      if [ "$st" = fail ]; then
394	        echo "verify: FAIL ($(jq -r '.step // "?"' "$vj" 2>/dev/null), $(jq -r '.attempts // 0' "$vj" 2>/dev/null) attempts)"
395	        exit 5
396	      fi
397	      exit 0 ;;
398	    reviewer)
399	      last=$(awk 'NF { l = $0 } END { print l }' "$report")
400	      case "$last" in
401	        "VERDICT: PASS") cat "$report"; exit 0 ;;
402	        "VERDICT: FAIL") cat "$report"; exit 5 ;;
403	      esac
404	      echo "harness: reviewer report has no final 'VERDICT: PASS|FAIL' line; ask it to rewrite the report." >&2
405	      exit 3 ;;
406	  esac
407	  cat "$report"
408	  exit 0
409	}

419	# ask_finish [rc] — replay the buffered stdout, log the ask, remove the temp
420	# file, exit. Runs once: normally after the inner ask, or from the EXIT/TERM/INT
421	# trap when the wrapper is killed mid-wait (rc 143/130 then).
422	ask_finish() {
423	  [ "$ASK_DONE" = 0 ] || return 0
424	  ASK_DONE=1
425	  local rc=${1:-1}
426	  if [ -n "$ASK_PID" ] && kill -0 "$ASK_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
427	    kill_tree "$ASK_PID"
428	  fi
429	  cat "$ASK_TMP" 2>/dev/null
430	  if [ -n "${ASK_ERR:-}" ] && [ -f "$ASK_ERR" ]; then cat "$ASK_ERR" >&2; fi
431	  record_progress "$ASK_AGENT" "$ASK_TEXT" "$rc" "$ASK_T0" "$ASK_HB" "$ASK_TMP" \
432	    || echo "harness: could not write the progress log (ask result unchanged)" >&2
433	  rm -f "$ASK_TMP" "${ASK_ERR:-}"
434	  exit "$rc"

437	# cmd_ask — runs ask_inner (which exits through many paths) in a background
438	# subshell and waits, then logs the outcome. Output and exit code are the inner
439	# ones; logging problems only warn on stderr.
440	cmd_ask() {
441	  [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ] || die "harness ask is for the conductor; a worker (HARNESS_ROLE=worker) does its task itself"
442	  # --no-lane (option position only, never inside the instruction): allow the implementer in the primary worktree
443	  local n=$# i=0 x
444	  ASK_NOLANE=0
445	  while [ "$i" -lt "$n" ]; do
446	    x=$1; shift; i=$((i + 1))
447	    if [ "$i" -gt 2 ] && [ "$x" = --no-lane ]; then ASK_NOLANE=1; else set -- "$@" "$x"; fi
448	  done
449	  [ "${1:-}" != implementer ] || [ "$ASK_NOLANE" = 1 ] || ! lane_in_primary \
450	    || die "refusing to run the implementer in the primary worktree: create a work folder with 'harness lane <issue#>' and use 'harness -C <folder> ask implementer ...' (--no-lane: only for tasks that do not change this repo)"
451	  local agent=${1:-} text=${2:-}
452	  case " $AGENTS " in *" $agent "*) ;; *) ask_inner "$@" ;; esac
453	  [ -n "$text" ] || ask_inner "$@"
454	  ask_parse_args "$@"
455	  ASK_TMP=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harness-ask.XXXXXX") || ask_inner "$@"
456	  ASK_AGENT=$agent ASK_TEXT=$text ASK_DONE=0 ASK_PID=""
457	  ASK_T0=$(date +%s); ASK_HB=$(git_head)
458	  trap 'ask_finish 143' TERM
459	  trap 'ask_finish 130' INT
460	  trap 'ask_finish 129' HUP
461	  trap 'ask_finish "$?"' EXIT
462	  ASK_ERR=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harness-err.XXXXXX") || ASK_ERR=   # not harness-ask.*: tests glob that prefix
463	  ( ask_inner "$@" ) > "$ASK_TMP" 2> "${ASK_ERR:-/dev/null}" &
464	  ASK_PID=$!
465	  wait "$ASK_PID"
466	  ask_finish "$?"
467	}

469	ask_inner() {
470	  local agent=${1:-} text=${2:-} timeout=$ASK_TIMEOUT keep=$ASK_KEEP
471	  [ -n "$agent" ] && [ -n "$text" ] || usage
472	  valid_agent "$agent"
473	  [ "$ASK_BAD" = 0 ] || usage      # a bad option found by ask_parse_args: usage error, logged
474	
475	  if [ "$agent" = implementer ] && ! command -v harness-verify >/dev/null 2>&1; then
476	    die "harness-verify not found on PATH; run ./install.sh (the implementer's checks would silently not run)"
477	  fi
478	
479	  ask_headless "$agent" "$text" "$timeout" "$keep"
480	}

482	# digits_only <string> — succeed only for a non-empty all-digit string
483	digits_only() {

487	# file_mtime <file> — epoch seconds. GNU `stat -c %Y` first (BSD/macOS stat has no
488	# -c and fails); `stat -f %m` second (on GNU, -f is filesystem mode and prints junk,
489	# so every result is validated as all digits).
490	file_mtime() {
491	  local mt
492	  mt=$(stat -c %Y "$1" 2>/dev/null) && digits_only "$mt" && { echo "$mt"; return 0; }
493	  mt=$(stat -f %m "$1" 2>/dev/null) && digits_only "$mt" && { echo "$mt"; return 0; }
494	  return 1
495	}

532	# log_close <role> <reason> [runner] — event line in progress.jsonl (key `role`, not
533	# `agent`, so per-agent ask lookups never match it) + progress.md refresh
534	log_close() {
535	  [ -n "$2" ] || return 0
536	  # no marker side effects: create .harness/ only at a checkout root (an existing one is used as is)
537	  [ -d .harness/asks ] || [ "$(harness_root "$PWD" 2>/dev/null)" = "$(pwd -P)" ] || return 0
538	  mkdir -p .harness 2>/dev/null || return 0
539	  jq -n -c --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg role "$1" --arg reason "$2" --arg runner "${3:-}" \
540	    '{ts: $ts, event: "close", role: $role, reason: $reason}
541	     + (if $runner != "" then {runner: $runner} else {} end)' >> "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null
542	  write_progress_md
543	  return 0
544	}
545	
546	cmd_close() {
547	  local target="" force=0
548	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
549	    case "$1" in
550	      --force) force=1 ;;
551	      -*) usage ;;
552	      *) [ -z "$target" ] || usage; target=$1 ;;
553	    esac
554	    shift
555	  done
556	  [ -n "$target" ] || usage
557	  valid_agent "$target"
558	  close_headless "$target" "$force"
559	  exit $?
560	}
561	
562	# --- harness checkout: init (decision 0010) -----------------------------------------
563	# require_checkout — ask acts only in an initialised checkout; run from a subdir,
564	# they continue at the checkout root (the conductor cannot cd), so .harness/ stays in one place
565	require_checkout() {
566	  local root
567	  root=$(harness_root "$PWD") || die "not a harness checkout (no .harness/asks); run 'harness init' here first"
568	  [ "$root" = "$(pwd -P)" ] || cd "$root" || die "cannot enter $root"
569	}
570	
571	# settings_commit TMP FILE — write TMP into FILE through the file (a symlinked FILE stays a
572	# symlink, as install.sh does) after one .bak copy of the original (never overwritten)
573	settings_commit() {
574	  local tmp=$1 f=$2
575	  [ -e "$f.bak" ] || cp "$f" "$f.bak" 2>/dev/null || return 1
576	  cat "$tmp" > "$f"
577	}
578	
579	# settings_set_agent FILE — create FILE with {"agent":"conductor"}, or merge the key into it
580	# (never clobbering other keys; .bak first); an existing different agent is kept and noted.
581	settings_set_agent() {
582	  local f=$1 cur tmp
583	  if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then
584	    mkdir -p "${f%/*}" || { echo "harness init: cannot create ${f%/*}" >&2; return 0; }
585	    jq -n '{agent: "conductor"}' > "$f" && echo "created $f (agent: conductor)"
586	    return 0
587	  fi
588	  if ! jq -e 'type == "object"' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
589	    echo "note: $f is not a JSON object; left alone (set \"agent\": \"conductor\" yourself)" >&2
590	    return 0
591	  fi
592	  cur=$(jq -r '.agent // empty' "$f")
593	  if [ "$cur" = conductor ]; then echo "$f: agent already conductor"; return 0; fi
594	  if [ -n "$cur" ]; then
595	    echo "note: $f sets agent \"$cur\"; kept (use --no-agent to silence this)"
596	    return 0
597	  fi
598	  tmp=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harness-settings.XXXXXX") || return 0
599	  if jq '.agent = "conductor"' "$f" > "$tmp" && settings_commit "$tmp" "$f"; then
600	    echo "updated $f (agent: conductor; backup $f.bak)"
601	  else
602	    echo "harness init: could not update $f" >&2
603	  fi
604	  rm -f "$tmp"
605	}
606	
607	# cmd_init [--no-agent] [--shared] — make the current repo (git toplevel, else the cwd) a harness
608	# checkout: .harness/asks/, the default config, "agent": "conductor" in .claude/settings.local.json
609	# (per user, untracked; --shared: .claude/settings.json, committed, never excluded), and every
610	# harness-made path (.harness/, settings.local.json(.bak), agent-memory, docs/superpowers; docs/wiki/inbox/ kept for old checkouts)
611	# in .git/info/exclude when git does not already ignore it. Idempotent.
612	cmd_init() {
613	  [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ] || die "harness init is for the conductor; a worker (HARNESS_ROLE=worker) does not set up checkouts"
614	  local agent=1 a p top ex target=.claude/settings.local.json
615	  for a in "$@"; do
616	    case "$a" in --no-agent) agent=0 ;; --shared) target=.claude/settings.json ;; *) usage ;; esac
617	  done
618	  top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || top=$PWD
619	  cd "$top" || die "cannot enter $top"
620	  echo "harness init: $top"
621	  if [ -d .harness/asks ]; then echo ".harness/asks exists"
622	  else mkdir -p .harness/asks || die "cannot create .harness/asks"; echo "created .harness/asks"; fi
623	  if [ -e "$CONFIG_FILE" ]; then echo "$CONFIG_FILE exists"
624	  else ensure_config init; [ -e "$CONFIG_FILE" ] && echo "created $CONFIG_FILE"; fi
625	  if [ "$agent" = 1 ]; then settings_set_agent "$target"
626	  else echo "$target untouched (--no-agent)"; fi
627	  if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
628	    ex=$(git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude 2>/dev/null)
629	    for a in .harness/ .claude/settings.local.json .claude/settings.local.json.bak .claude/agent-memory/ docs/wiki/inbox/ docs/superpowers/; do
630	      case "$a" in */) p=${a}x ;; *) p=$a ;; esac
631	      if git check-ignore -q "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo "$a already ignored by git"
632	      elif [ -n "$ex" ] && mkdir -p "${ex%/*}" && printf '%s\n' "$a" >> "$ex"; then echo "added $a to $ex"
633	      else echo "note: could not add $a to git's exclude file" >&2; fi
634	    done
635	  fi
636	  echo "workers run as detached headless Claude sessions: watch a run with 'harness watch <role>'"
637	  return 0
638	}
639	
640	need jq
641	# global -C DIR (like git -C): every subcommand then runs in DIR, whose .harness/ state is its own
642	if [ "${1:-}" = -C ]; then
643	  [ -n "${2:-}" ] || usage
644	  cd "$2" 2>/dev/null || die "cannot enter $2"
645	  shift 2
646	fi
647	# _mtime prints a file's epoch mtime (tests: fake GNU/BSD stat on PATH)
648	if [ "${1:-}" = _mtime ]; then file_mtime "${2:-}"; exit $?; fi
649	# _defaults prints the shared defaults as KEY=VALUE (tests: prose copies are checked against it)
650	if [ "${1:-}" = _defaults ]; then
651	  for k in $(compgen -v HARNESS_ | grep -E '^HARNESS_(ROLES|[A-Z_]+_(MS|DEFAULT))$' | sort); do eval "printf '%s=%s\n' \"$k\" \"\${$k}\""; done
652	  exit 0
653	fi
654	# init is file work: no checkout needed
655	if [ "${1:-}" = init ]; then shift; cmd_init "$@"; exit $?; fi
656	# lane works on git worktrees from anywhere
657	if [ "${1:-}" = lane ]; then shift; cmd_lane "$@"; exit $?; fi
658	# wiki-lint is pure file checking
659	if [ "${1:-}" = wiki-lint ]; then shift; cmd_wiki_lint "$@"; exit $?; fi
660	# metrics reads files only
661	if [ "${1:-}" = metrics ]; then shift; cmd_metrics "$@"; exit $?; fi
662	
663	# ask acts only in an initialised checkout (decision 0010); status/report/close work anywhere
664	case "${1:-}" in
665	  ask) [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" = worker ] || require_checkout ;;
666	esac
667	case "${1:-}" in
668	  ask|status) ensure_config "$1" ;;
669	esac
670	case "${1:-}" in
671	  ask)    shift; cmd_ask "$@" ;;
672	  report) shift; cmd_report "$@" ;;
673	  wait)   shift; cmd_wait "$@" ;;
674	  watch)  shift; cmd_watch "$@" ;;
675	  open-watch) shift; cmd_open_watch "$@" ;;
676	  status) cmd_status ;;
677	  close)  shift; cmd_close "$@" ;;
678	  *)      usage ;;
679	esac
680	exit $?
681	}

#!/bin/bash
# The body is one brace group: bash parses the whole file before running any of it, so a
# tool that rewrites this file in place cannot corrupt a run in progress (wiki: troubleshooting).
{
# harness — conductor-side wrapper for detached headless Claude workers (decision 0011).
#
#   harness ask    <agent> '<instruction>' [--timeout MS] [--keep]
#     default --timeout = the role's headless run cap (a background ask returns when the run ends):
#     implementer 5400000, analyst/reviewer 3600000
#   harness report <agent>
#   harness wait   <agent> [--timeout MS]   block until the run ends (0 done, 3 no ask/gone, 4 timeout); does not collect
#   harness watch  <agent> [-n N]   human terminal only: follow a live run, or the last N lines of a finished one
#   harness status
#   harness [-C DIR] <command> ...   run as if started in DIR (a work folder)
#   harness lane <issue#> [slug] [--type feat|fix|docs] | lane ls | lane rm <issue#|path> [--force]   per-issue work folders (git worktrees)
#   harness init [--no-agent] [--shared]   make this repo a harness checkout (.harness/asks, config, agent=conductor in .claude/settings.local.json; --shared: settings.json)
#   harness close  <agent> [--force]
#   harness metrics [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--json]   health numbers from progress.jsonl + the wiki
#   harness wiki-lint [DIR]   check docs/wiki format and limits (0 = pass)
#
# Exit codes for `ask`: 0 report printed · 1 usage/setup error
#                       2 the run was denied a tool call and wrote no report (re-ask with a changed brief)
#                       3 worker finished without a report
#                       4 run still going / unknown (a background ask returns when the run ends)
#                       5 verification failed (implementer's checks gave up, or the
#                         reviewer's last line is `VERDICT: FAIL`); the report is
#                         still printed on stdout. A reviewer report without a
#                         final VERDICT line counts as no valid report (3).
# `report` prints .harness/reports/<agent>.md with the same exit codes as `ask`
#   (0 · 3 no report/no VERDICT · 5 verification failed), plus 4 while the run is
#   still going. It never sends a prompt.
# Workers (HARNESS_ROLE=worker) may not ask: skills are user-global and would otherwise nest.
# .harness/ lives in the checkout root: `harness init` creates it; ask refuses without it
# and, run from a subdir of the checkout, continues at the root.
# Every ask is logged to .harness/log/ and .harness/progress.jsonl, and
# .harness/progress.md is regenerated (log errors only warn on stderr).
# Config: .harness/config.json (optional `headless_max_minutes`). `harness close` refuses (exit 4) a
#   running ask unless --force. Closes are logged to progress.jsonl.
# Output of `ask`: stdout = report on exit 0 and 5; diagnostics on stderr.
set -u

# lib/ is sourced eagerly, here, inside the brace group: bash 3.2 reads a sourced file whole,
# so an in-place edit cannot corrupt the run (a lazily sourced file would lose that protection).
# The symlinked $0 is resolved by hand (no readlink -f on old macOS).
src=${BASH_SOURCE[0]}
while [ -L "$src" ]; do
  case $src in */*) d=$(CDPATH= cd -P "${src%/*}" && pwd) ;; *) d=$PWD ;; esac
  src=$(readlink "$src")
  case $src in /*) ;; *) src=$d/$src ;; esac
done
case $src in */*) d=${src%/*} ;; *) d=. ;; esac   # no dirname: PATH may be bare in hooks/tests
HARNESS_LIB=${HARNESS_LIB:-$(CDPATH= cd -P "$d/../lib" 2>/dev/null && pwd)}
# Explicit list, fixed order, no glob: a stray file in lib/ is never sourced. Definitions only.
for m in defaults root metrics headless dash lane openwatch; do
  . "$HARNESS_LIB/harness-$m.sh" 2>/dev/null || { echo "harness: cannot load lib/harness-$m.sh" >&2; exit 1; }
done
unset src d m
# end loader

AGENTS=$HARNESS_ROLES
REPORT_DIR=".harness/reports"
LOG_DIR=".harness/log"
JSONL=".harness/progress.jsonl"
PROGRESS_MD=".harness/progress.md"
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT=$HARNESS_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
IMPLEMENTER_TIMEOUT=$HARNESS_IMPLEMENTER_TIMEOUT_MS
ASK_DIR=".harness/asks"
# parsed once by ask_parse_args (cmd_ask); ask_inner only reads them
ASK_TIMEOUT=$DEFAULT_TIMEOUT; ASK_TIMEOUT_SET=0; ASK_KEEP=0; ASK_BAD=0; ASK_NOLANE=0

usage() {
  cat >&2 <<EOF
usage:
  harness ask    <agent> '<instruction>' [--timeout MS (default: implementer $IMPLEMENTER_TIMEOUT, others $DEFAULT_TIMEOUT)] [--keep]
  harness report <agent>
  harness wait   <agent> [--timeout MS]
  harness watch  <agent> [-n N]   (human terminal only)
  harness status
  harness [-C DIR] <command> ...
  harness lane   <issue#> [slug] [--type feat|fix|docs] | ls | rm <issue#|path> [--force]
  harness init   [--no-agent] [--shared]   (once per repo: makes it a harness checkout; ask refuses without it)
  harness close  <agent> [--force]
  harness wiki-lint [DIR]
  harness metrics [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--json]
agents: $AGENTS
EOF
  exit 1
}

die() { echo "harness: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "$1 not found on PATH"; }

valid_agent() {
  case " $AGENTS " in
    *" $1 "*) return 0 ;;
  esac
  die "unknown agent '$1' (expected one of: $AGENTS)"
}

# fmt_ctx <tokens> — "137k", or "-" when unknown
fmt_ctx() {
  case "${1:-}" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*) echo - ;;
    *) echo "$(($1 / 1000))k" ;;
  esac
}

# last_ask_record <agent> [--where JQ] [--field JQ]
# The newest progress line of <agent> among the last 200 non-close lines that has no ask_id
# (old rows: the removed --worktree asks logged `agent: <role>` plus an ask_id and must never
# stand in for a plain ask) and matches the extra jq condition --where. Prints --field (default: the compact line); nothing = unknown.
# --where/--field are jq source from the caller's own literals.
last_ask_record() {
  local agent=$1 where=true field=. prog
  shift
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --where) where=$2; shift 2 ;;
      --field) field=$2; shift 2 ;;
      *) return 2 ;;
    esac
  done
  prog="fromjson? | select(type == \"object\" and .agent == \$a and (.ask_id // \"\") == \"\") | select($where) | $field"
  grep -v '"event":"close"' "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 200 \
    | jq -R -r -c --arg a "$agent" "$prog" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1
}

# --- progress log ----------------------------------------------------------------------

git_head() { git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; }
# file_sum <file> — cksum "crc-size" of a file (portable), empty if unreadable
file_sum() { cksum < "$1" 2>/dev/null | awk '{ print $1 "-" $2 }'; }
num_or_null() { case "${1:-}" in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo null ;; *) echo "$1" ;; esac; }

# record_progress <agent> <text> <rc> <t0> <head_before> <stdout-file>
# Writes the log file + jsonl line, rotates, regenerates progress.md.
record_progress() {
  local agent=$1 text=$2 rc=$3 t0=$4 hb=$5 out=$6 cb=
  local report="$REPORT_DIR/$agent.md" vj=.harness/verify/implementer.json rmt
  local now ts stamp ha sess ca status="" summary="" verify="" logf n brief sha="" va="" hl='{}'
  now=$(date +%s)
  # a report older than this ask is a previous ask's (this one died before archiving it)
  if [ -f "$report" ]; then rmt=$(file_mtime "$report") && [ "$rmt" -ge "$t0" ] || report=/dev/null.none; fi
  ts=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  stamp=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
  ha=$(git_head)
  # session and context come from the run's exit.json
  hl=$(hl_progress_obj "$agent" "$t0")
  sess=$(printf '%s' "$hl" | jq -r '.session // empty' 2>/dev/null)
  ca=$(printf '%s' "$hl" | jq -r '.ctx_after // empty' 2>/dev/null)
  cb=$(sed -n 's/^ctx_before=//p' "$ASK_DIR/$agent.run" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
  hl=$(printf '%s' "$hl" | jq -c 'del(.session, .ctx_after)' 2>/dev/null) || hl='{}'
  if [ -f "$report" ]; then
    status=$(sed -n 's/^status: *//p' "$report" | head -n 1)
    summary=$(sed -n 's/^# *//p' "$report" | head -n 1)
    sha=$(file_sum "$report")
  fi
  if [ "$agent" = implementer ]; then
    verify=$(jq -r '.status // empty' "$vj" 2>/dev/null)
    va=$(jq -r '.attempts // empty' "$vj" 2>/dev/null)
    grep -q '^verify: INTERRUPTED' "$out" 2>/dev/null && verify=interrupted
  fi

  mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" || return 1
  logf="$LOG_DIR/$stamp-$agent.md"; n=1
  while [ -e "$logf" ]; do n=$((n + 1)); logf="$LOG_DIR/$stamp-$agent-$n.md"; done
  brief=$(printf '%s' "$text" | grep -o '\.harness/task-[A-Za-z0-9_.-]*\.md' | head -n 1)
  {
    printf '# %s ask %s (exit %s, %ss)\n\n## Instruction\n\n%s\n' "$agent" "$ts" "$rc" "$((now - t0))" "$text"
    if [ -n "$brief" ] && [ -f "$brief" ]; then
      printf '\n## Brief (%s)\n\n' "$brief"; cat "$brief"
    fi
    if [ -f "$report" ]; then
      printf '\n## Report\n\n'; cat "$report"
    else
      printf '\n## Screen / output (no report)\n\n'; cat "$out"
      if [ "$hl" != '{}' ]; then
        printf '\n## Run output (last 40 lines)\n\n'
        hl_view_tail "$agent" 40
      fi
    fi
    if [ -s "${ASK_ERR:-}" ]; then
      printf '\n## Errors\n\n'; cat "$ASK_ERR"
    fi
    if [ "$hl" != '{}' ]; then
      printf '\n## Run\n\n'
      printf '%s' "$hl" | jq -r '"result \(.result // "-"), turns \(.turns // "-"), cost $\(.cost_usd // "-"), stream \(.stream_log // "-")"' 2>/dev/null
    fi
  } > "$logf" || return 1

  # rotate the jsonl first so the new line lands in the fresh file
  if [ -f "$JSONL" ] && [ "$(wc -c < "$JSONL" | tr -d ' ')" -gt "${HARNESS_JSONL_MAX:-1048576}" ]; then
    mv "$JSONL" "$JSONL.$stamp" && gzip -f "$JSONL.$stamp"
  fi
  jq -n -c --arg ts "$ts" --arg agent "$agent" --arg session "$sess" \
    --arg instr "$(printf '%s' "$text" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-160)" \
    --argjson exit "$rc" --arg verify "$verify" --argjson dur "$((now - t0))" \
    --arg hb "$hb" --arg ha "$ha" --argjson cb "$(num_or_null "$cb")" --argjson ca "$(num_or_null "$ca")" \
    --arg status "$status" --arg summary "$summary" --arg sha "$sha" --argjson va "$(num_or_null "$va")" \
    --argjson hl "$hl" --argjson nl "${ASK_NOLANE:-0}" '
    def nz: if . == "" then null else . end;
    {ts: $ts, agent: $agent, session: ($session | nz), instr: $instr, exit: $exit,
     verify: ($verify | nz), verify_attempts: $va, dur_s: $dur, head_before: ($hb | nz), head_after: ($ha | nz),
     ctx_before: $cb, ctx_after: $ca, status: ($status | nz), summary: ($summary | nz), report_sha: ($sha | nz)} + (if $nl == 1 then {no_lane: true} else {} end) + $hl' >> "$JSONL" || return 1

  rotate_logs "$logf"
  write_progress_md
  return 0
}

# ask_parse_args <agent> <text> [opts...] — the one walk over an ask's options (called by cmd_ask
# after the agent and text checks). Sets ASK_TIMEOUT/KEEP.
# The instruction text is positional, so an option-looking word inside it is never an option. A bad option,
# --timeout value only sets ASK_BAD: ask_inner turns that into the usage
# error inside the logged subshell (exit 1 is recorded in progress).
ask_parse_args() {
  local agent=$1
  shift 2
  ASK_KEEP=0; ASK_BAD=0
  ASK_TIMEOUT=$DEFAULT_TIMEOUT; ASK_TIMEOUT_SET=0
  [ "$agent" != implementer ] || ASK_TIMEOUT=$IMPLEMENTER_TIMEOUT
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --timeout)
        case "${2:-}" in
          ''|*[!0-9]*|0) ASK_BAD=1; shift ;;     # missing/invalid value: usage (logged)
          *) ASK_TIMEOUT=$2; ASK_TIMEOUT_SET=1; shift 2 ;;
        esac ;;
      --keep) ASK_KEEP=1; shift ;;
      *) ASK_BAD=1; shift ;;
    esac
  done
}

# rotate_logs <current-log> — newest N logs kept, older than D days deleted; raw headless
# streams are gzipped once a day old and dropped with the logs
rotate_logs() {
  local f
  ls -1t "$LOG_DIR"/*.md 2>/dev/null | grep -vxF -- "$1" | tail -n +"${HARNESS_LOG_KEEP:-200}" \
    | while IFS= read -r f; do rm -f "$f"; done
  find "$LOG_DIR" -name '*.md' -mtime "+${HARNESS_LOG_DAYS:-14}" 2>/dev/null \
    | grep -vxF -- "$1" | while IFS= read -r f; do rm -f "$f"; done
  find "$LOG_DIR" -name '*.jsonl' -mtime +0 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r f; do gzip -f "$f" 2>/dev/null; done
  find "$LOG_DIR" \( -name '*.jsonl' -o -name '*.jsonl.gz' \) -mtime "+${HARNESS_LOG_DAYS:-14}" 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r f; do rm -f "$f"; done
  return 0
}

# write_progress_md — regenerate .harness/progress.md (<= 60 lines)
write_progress_md() {
  local tmp="$PROGRESS_MD.tmp.$$" branch goal a f q line=""
  branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "-")
  goal="(unset)"
  if [ -s .harness/goal.md ]; then
    goal=$(tr '\n' ' ' < .harness/goal.md | sed 's/  */ /g; s/ $//' | cut -c1-400)
  fi
  {
    printf '# Progress — %s (%s)\n' "$(basename "$PWD")" "$branch"
    printf 'Goal: %s\n' "$goal"
    printf '## Recent asks (newest first, max 15)\n'
    grep -v '"event":"close"' "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 15 | jq -r -R 'fromjson? | "- \(.ts) \(.agent) \(if .late then "late report" else "exit \(.exit)" end) verify \(.verify // "-") \(.head_before // "")..\(.head_after // "") — \(.summary // "")"' 2>/dev/null \
      | awk '{ a[NR] = $0 } END { for (i = NR; i >= 1; i--) print a[i] }'
    q=$(grep '"event":"close"' "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 5 | jq -r -R 'fromjson? | "\(.ts) \(.role) (\(.reason // "?"))"' 2>/dev/null \
      | awk '{ a[NR] = $0 } END { for (i = NR; i >= 1; i--) printf "%s%s", (i == NR ? "" : "; "), a[i]; if (NR) print "" }')
    [ -z "$q" ] || printf 'Recent closes (max 5): %s\n' "$q"
    for f in $(ls -t .harness/reports/*.md 2>/dev/null); do
      q=$(awk '/^## Open questions/ { on = 1; next } /^## / { on = 0 } on && /^- / { if (tolower($0) !~ /^- *none *$/) print }' "$f" | head -n 10)
      if [ -n "$q" ]; then
        printf '## Open questions (from %s)\n%s\n' "$(basename "$f" .md)" "$q"
        break
      fi
    done
    printf '## Workers\n'
    for a in $AGENTS; do
      q=$(hl_status_line "$a" progress)
      if [ -z "$line" ]; then line=$q; else line="$line · $q"; fi
    done
    printf -- '- %s\n' "$line"
  } 2>/dev/null | head -n 60 > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$PROGRESS_MD"
}

# verify_tool ARGS... — run harness-verify from PATH (installed by ./install.sh)
verify_tool() {
  command -v harness-verify >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
  harness-verify "$@"
}

# restore_interrupted <agent> <report> — implementer only: the Stop hook hides the
# report as <report>.pending while it verifies. If the hook was killed, only the
# .pending file is left: restore it and exit 5. Callers must have checked the agent
# is idle/done (a working agent may still be verifying; never restore then).
restore_interrupted() {
  [ "$1" = implementer ] && [ ! -f "$2" ] && [ -f "$2.pending" ] || return 0
  mv -f "$2.pending" "$2"
  cat "$2"
  echo "verify: INTERRUPTED"
  exit 5
}

# learned_has_evidence <text> — the bullet cites an ask-id, a commit (7-40 hex with a
# letter a-f and a digit, standalone), path/file.ext:line (path has a / or an extension),
# a .harness/ path or a .log file. `step:2`, `host:8080` and bare numbers do not count.
learned_has_evidence() {
  printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -Eq '(^|[^0-9])[0-9]{9,}-[0-9]+-[0-9]+|[A-Za-z0-9_.-]*/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]*:[0-9]+|[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,4}:[0-9]+|\.harness/|\.log([^A-Za-z]|$)' && return 0
  printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -Eo '(^|[^0-9A-Za-z])[0-9a-f]{7,40}($|[^0-9A-Za-z])' | grep '[0-9]' | grep -q '[a-f]' && return 0
  return 1
}

# queue_learned <agent> <report> — file each evidence-backed bullet of the report's
# optional `## Notes` section (legacy `## Learned` is also accepted) as a GitHub
# issue labelled `wiki` (title: first 70 chars; body: bullet + source line).
# Indented continuation lines are joined to their bullet. An open `wiki` issue
# with the same title is skipped. Bullets without evidence are dropped with a
# one-line stderr warning. Never fails the caller: no gh, a failing gh or no
# ask-id print one warning and continue.
queue_learned() {
  local agent=$1 report=$2 raw line kept="" n=0 dropped=0 askid date title body open made=0 skipped=0
  raw=$(awk '
    function flush() { if (cur != "") print cur; cur = "" }
    /^## (Learned|Notes)[ \t]*$/ { on = 1; next }
    on && (/^## / || /^VERDICT:/) { flush(); on = 0 }
    on && /^[ \t]*[-*] / { flush(); cur = $0; sub(/^[ \t]*[-*] +/, "- ", cur); next }
    on && cur != "" && /^[ \t]+[^ \t]/ { t = $0; sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", t); cur = cur " " t; next }
    on && /^[ \t]*$/ { flush() }
    END { flush() }
  ' "$report" 2>/dev/null) || return 0
  [ -n "$raw" ] || return 0
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    case "$line" in "- none"|"- None"|"- none."|"- -") continue ;; esac
    if learned_has_evidence "$line"; then
      n=$((n + 1))
      kept="$kept$line
"
    else
      dropped=$((dropped + 1))
    fi
  done <<EOF_LEARNED
$raw
EOF_LEARNED
  [ "$dropped" -eq 0 ] || echo "harness: wiki: dropped $dropped Notes bullet(s) without evidence (ask-id, commit, file:line or log)" >&2
  [ -n "$kept" ] || return 0
  askid=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$agent.current" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -z "$askid" ]; then
    echo "harness: wiki: no ask-id for $agent; Notes bullets not filed" >&2
    return 0
  fi
  if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "harness: wiki: gh not found; Notes bullets not filed as issues" >&2
    return 0
  fi
  date=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
  open=$(gh issue list --label wiki --state open --limit 200 --json title --jq '.[].title' 2>/dev/null) || {
    echo "harness: wiki: gh issue list failed; Notes bullets not filed as issues" >&2
    return 0
  }
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    [ -n "$line" ] || continue
    line=${line#- }
    title=$(printf '%s' "$line" | cut -c1-70)
    if printf '%s\n' "$open" | grep -qxF -- "$title"; then
      skipped=$((skipped + 1))
      continue
    fi
    body="$line

Source: $agent ask $askid, $date"
    if gh issue create --label wiki --title "$title" --body "$body" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      made=$((made + 1))
      open="$open
$title"
    else
      echo "harness: wiki: gh issue create failed; remaining Notes bullets not filed" >&2
      break
    fi
  done <<EOF_KEPT
$kept
EOF_KEPT
  [ "$made" -eq 0 ] && [ "$skipped" -eq 0 ] && return 0
  echo "wiki: $made issue$([ "$made" -eq 1 ] || echo s) filed with label wiki ($skipped duplicate skipped)"
}

# finish_report <agent> <report> — print the report and exit with the
# verification-aware status (0 pass · 3 reviewer without VERDICT · 5 failed)
finish_report() {
  local agent=$1 report=$2 last vj st
  queue_learned "$agent" "$report"
  case "$agent" in
    implementer)
      vj=".harness/verify/implementer.json"
      st=$(jq -r '.status // empty' "$vj" 2>/dev/null)
      cat "$report"
      if [ "$st" = fail ]; then
        echo "verify: FAIL ($(jq -r '.step // "?"' "$vj" 2>/dev/null), $(jq -r '.attempts // 0' "$vj" 2>/dev/null) attempts)"
        exit 5
      fi
      exit 0 ;;
    reviewer)
      last=$(awk 'NF { l = $0 } END { print l }' "$report")
      case "$last" in
        "VERDICT: PASS") cat "$report"; exit 0 ;;
        "VERDICT: FAIL") cat "$report"; exit 5 ;;
      esac
      echo "harness: reviewer report has no final 'VERDICT: PASS|FAIL' line; ask it to rewrite the report." >&2
      exit 3 ;;
  esac
  cat "$report"
  exit 0
}

# kill_tree <pid> — TERM pid and all its descendants (macOS has no setsid)
kill_tree() {
  local c
  for c in $(pgrep -P "$1" 2>/dev/null); do kill_tree "$c"; done
  kill "$1" 2>/dev/null
  return 0
}

# ask_finish [rc] — replay the buffered stdout, log the ask, remove the temp
# file, exit. Runs once: normally after the inner ask, or from the EXIT/TERM/INT
# trap when the wrapper is killed mid-wait (rc 143/130 then).
ask_finish() {
  [ "$ASK_DONE" = 0 ] || return 0
  ASK_DONE=1
  local rc=${1:-1}
  if [ -n "$ASK_PID" ] && kill -0 "$ASK_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill_tree "$ASK_PID"
  fi
  cat "$ASK_TMP" 2>/dev/null
  if [ -n "${ASK_ERR:-}" ] && [ -f "$ASK_ERR" ]; then cat "$ASK_ERR" >&2; fi
  record_progress "$ASK_AGENT" "$ASK_TEXT" "$rc" "$ASK_T0" "$ASK_HB" "$ASK_TMP" \
    || echo "harness: could not write the progress log (ask result unchanged)" >&2
  rm -f "$ASK_TMP" "${ASK_ERR:-}"
  exit "$rc"
}

# cmd_ask — runs ask_inner (which exits through many paths) in a background
# subshell and waits, then logs the outcome. Output and exit code are the inner
# ones; logging problems only warn on stderr.
cmd_ask() {
  [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ] || die "harness ask is for the conductor; a worker (HARNESS_ROLE=worker) does its task itself"
  # --no-lane (option position only, never inside the instruction): allow the implementer in the primary worktree
  local n=$# i=0 x
  ASK_NOLANE=0
  while [ "$i" -lt "$n" ]; do
    x=$1; shift; i=$((i + 1))
    if [ "$i" -gt 2 ] && [ "$x" = --no-lane ]; then ASK_NOLANE=1; else set -- "$@" "$x"; fi
  done
  [ "${1:-}" != implementer ] || [ "$ASK_NOLANE" = 1 ] || ! lane_in_primary \
    || die "refusing to run the implementer in the primary worktree: create a work folder with 'harness lane <issue#>' and use 'harness -C <folder> ask implementer ...' (--no-lane: only for tasks that do not change this repo)"
  local agent=${1:-} text=${2:-}
  case " $AGENTS " in *" $agent "*) ;; *) ask_inner "$@" ;; esac
  [ -n "$text" ] || ask_inner "$@"
  ask_parse_args "$@"
  ASK_TMP=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harness-ask.XXXXXX") || ask_inner "$@"
  ASK_AGENT=$agent ASK_TEXT=$text ASK_DONE=0 ASK_PID=""
  ASK_T0=$(date +%s); ASK_HB=$(git_head)
  trap 'ask_finish 143' TERM
  trap 'ask_finish 130' INT
  trap 'ask_finish 129' HUP
  trap 'ask_finish "$?"' EXIT
  ASK_ERR=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harness-err.XXXXXX") || ASK_ERR=   # not harness-ask.*: tests glob that prefix
  ( ask_inner "$@" ) > "$ASK_TMP" 2> "${ASK_ERR:-/dev/null}" &
  ASK_PID=$!
  wait "$ASK_PID"
  ask_finish "$?"
}

ask_inner() {
  local agent=${1:-} text=${2:-} timeout=$ASK_TIMEOUT keep=$ASK_KEEP
  [ -n "$agent" ] && [ -n "$text" ] || usage
  valid_agent "$agent"
  [ "$ASK_BAD" = 0 ] || usage      # a bad option found by ask_parse_args: usage error, logged

  if [ "$agent" = implementer ] && ! command -v harness-verify >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    die "harness-verify not found on PATH; run ./install.sh (the implementer's checks would silently not run)"
  fi

  ask_headless "$agent" "$text" "$timeout" "$keep"
}

# digits_only <string> — succeed only for a non-empty all-digit string
digits_only() {
  case "$1" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
}

# file_mtime <file> — epoch seconds. GNU `stat -c %Y` first (BSD/macOS stat has no
# -c and fails); `stat -f %m` second (on GNU, -f is filesystem mode and prints junk,
# so every result is validated as all digits).
file_mtime() {
  local mt
  mt=$(stat -c %Y "$1" 2>/dev/null) && digits_only "$mt" && { echo "$mt"; return 0; }
  mt=$(stat -f %m "$1" 2>/dev/null) && digits_only "$mt" && { echo "$mt"; return 0; }
  return 1
}

cmd_report() {
  local agent=${1:-}
  [ -n "$agent" ] || usage
  valid_agent "$agent"
  report_headless "$agent"
}

cmd_status() {
  local a
  for a in $AGENTS; do hl_status_line "$a" status; done
}

# --- config, close -----------------------------------------------------------------------
CONFIG_FILE=".harness/config.json"

# config_template — the documented default config (what ensure_config writes)
config_template() {
  cat <<'EOC'
{
  "_doc": "Optional key: headless_max_minutes (number) overrides the headless run cap, in minutes."
}
EOC
}

# ensure_config — create the documented default config when absent (never fatal); an existing
# file is never touched.
ensure_config() {
  # Never creates .harness/ (stray dirs break harness-verify's root lookup): `harness init`
  # does that. Workers and anything outside an initialised checkout (no .harness/asks) skip.
  [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ] || return 0
  [ -d .harness/asks ] || return 0
  [ -e "$CONFIG_FILE" ] || config_template > "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null
  return 0
}

# log_close <role> <reason> [runner] — event line in progress.jsonl (key `role`, not
# `agent`, so per-agent ask lookups never match it) + progress.md refresh
log_close() {
  [ -n "$2" ] || return 0
  # no marker side effects: create .harness/ only at a checkout root (an existing one is used as is)
  [ -d .harness/asks ] || [ "$(harness_root "$PWD" 2>/dev/null)" = "$(pwd -P)" ] || return 0
  mkdir -p .harness 2>/dev/null || return 0
  jq -n -c --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg role "$1" --arg reason "$2" --arg runner "${3:-}" \
    '{ts: $ts, event: "close", role: $role, reason: $reason}
     + (if $runner != "" then {runner: $runner} else {} end)' >> "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null
  write_progress_md
  return 0
}

cmd_close() {
  local target="" force=0
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --force) force=1 ;;
      -*) usage ;;
      *) [ -z "$target" ] || usage; target=$1 ;;
    esac
    shift
  done
  [ -n "$target" ] || usage
  valid_agent "$target"
  close_headless "$target" "$force"
  exit $?
}

# --- harness checkout: init (decision 0010) -----------------------------------------
# require_checkout — ask acts only in an initialised checkout; run from a subdir,
# they continue at the checkout root (the conductor cannot cd), so .harness/ stays in one place
require_checkout() {
  local root
  root=$(harness_root "$PWD") || die "not a harness checkout (no .harness/asks); run 'harness init' here first"
  [ "$root" = "$(pwd -P)" ] || cd "$root" || die "cannot enter $root"
}

# settings_commit TMP FILE — write TMP into FILE through the file (a symlinked FILE stays a
# symlink, as install.sh does) after one .bak copy of the original (never overwritten)
settings_commit() {
  local tmp=$1 f=$2
  [ -e "$f.bak" ] || cp "$f" "$f.bak" 2>/dev/null || return 1
  cat "$tmp" > "$f"
}

# settings_set_agent FILE — create FILE with {"agent":"conductor"}, or merge the key into it
# (never clobbering other keys; .bak first); an existing different agent is kept and noted.
settings_set_agent() {
  local f=$1 cur tmp
  if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then
    mkdir -p "${f%/*}" || { echo "harness init: cannot create ${f%/*}" >&2; return 0; }
    jq -n '{agent: "conductor"}' > "$f" && echo "created $f (agent: conductor)"
    return 0
  fi
  if ! jq -e 'type == "object"' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "note: $f is not a JSON object; left alone (set \"agent\": \"conductor\" yourself)" >&2
    return 0
  fi
  cur=$(jq -r '.agent // empty' "$f")
  if [ "$cur" = conductor ]; then echo "$f: agent already conductor"; return 0; fi
  if [ -n "$cur" ]; then
    echo "note: $f sets agent \"$cur\"; kept (use --no-agent to silence this)"
    return 0
  fi
  tmp=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harness-settings.XXXXXX") || return 0
  if jq '.agent = "conductor"' "$f" > "$tmp" && settings_commit "$tmp" "$f"; then
    echo "updated $f (agent: conductor; backup $f.bak)"
  else
    echo "harness init: could not update $f" >&2
  fi
  rm -f "$tmp"
}

# cmd_init [--no-agent] [--shared] — make the current repo (git toplevel, else the cwd) a harness
# checkout: .harness/asks/, the default config, "agent": "conductor" in .claude/settings.local.json
# (per user, untracked; --shared: .claude/settings.json, committed, never excluded), and every
# harness-made path (.harness/, settings.local.json(.bak), agent-memory, docs/superpowers; docs/wiki/inbox/ kept for old checkouts)
# in .git/info/exclude when git does not already ignore it. Idempotent.
cmd_init() {
  [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ] || die "harness init is for the conductor; a worker (HARNESS_ROLE=worker) does not set up checkouts"
  local agent=1 a p top ex target=.claude/settings.local.json
  for a in "$@"; do
    case "$a" in --no-agent) agent=0 ;; --shared) target=.claude/settings.json ;; *) usage ;; esac
  done
  top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || top=$PWD
  cd "$top" || die "cannot enter $top"
  echo "harness init: $top"
  if [ -d .harness/asks ]; then echo ".harness/asks exists"
  else mkdir -p .harness/asks || die "cannot create .harness/asks"; echo "created .harness/asks"; fi
  if [ -e "$CONFIG_FILE" ]; then echo "$CONFIG_FILE exists"
  else ensure_config init; [ -e "$CONFIG_FILE" ] && echo "created $CONFIG_FILE"; fi
  if [ "$agent" = 1 ]; then settings_set_agent "$target"
  else echo "$target untouched (--no-agent)"; fi
  if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ex=$(git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude 2>/dev/null)
    for a in .harness/ .claude/settings.local.json .claude/settings.local.json.bak .claude/agent-memory/ docs/wiki/inbox/ docs/superpowers/; do
      case "$a" in */) p=${a}x ;; *) p=$a ;; esac
      if git check-ignore -q "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo "$a already ignored by git"
      elif [ -n "$ex" ] && mkdir -p "${ex%/*}" && printf '%s\n' "$a" >> "$ex"; then echo "added $a to $ex"
      else echo "note: could not add $a to git's exclude file" >&2; fi
    done
  fi
  echo "workers run as detached headless Claude sessions: watch a run with 'harness watch <role>'"
  return 0
}

if [ "${1:-}" = -C ]; then

1	# Shared helpers for the harness*.test.sh suites (sourced, not a suite itself).
     2	# Sourcing suite must `set -u` first; $0 is then that suite, so HERE is tests/.
     3	HERE=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
     4	HARNESS="$HERE/../bin/harness"
     5	pass=0
     6	fail=0
     7	
     8	# hinit — make the current dir a harness checkout (what `harness init` does, minus the agent
     9	# settings); ask refuses without it. Leaves OUT/RC alone.
    10	hinit() { env -u HARNESS_ROLE /bin/bash "$HARNESS" init --no-agent >/dev/null 2>&1; }
    11	
    12	# fresh WORK FAKE_DIR per case; every case starts as an initialised checkout (hinit); all of them removed on exit
    13	WORKS=""
    14	trap 'cd / && for d in $WORKS; do rm -rf "$d"; done' EXIT
    15	setup() {
    16	  WORK=$(mktemp -d)
    17	  WORKS="$WORKS $WORK"
    18	  export FAKE_DIR="$WORK/fake"
    19	  export FAKE_LOG="$WORK/claude.log"
    20	  mkdir -p "$FAKE_DIR"
    21	  : > "$FAKE_LOG"
    22	  unset FAKE_PROMPT_HOOK
    23	  export HARNESS_POLL_SEC=0.2
    24	  cd "$WORK" || exit 1
    25	  hinit
    26	}
    27	
    28	# run ARGS... -> sets OUT, RC  (killed by SIGALRM after 10s so a hang fails fast)
    29	GUARD="perl -e alarm(10);exec(@ARGV)"
    30	run() {
    31	  OUT=$(HARNESS_POLL_SEC=0.2 PATH="$HERE/../bin:$PATH" $GUARD env -u HARNESS_ROLE /bin/bash "$HARNESS" "$@" 2>&1)
    32	  RC=$?
    33	}
    34	
    35	# FAKE_LOG holds `printf %q` of each fake-claude argv: match literally (spaces inside an
    36	# argument appear as "\ ").
    37	logged() { grep -qF -- "$1" "$FAKE_LOG"; }
    38	not_logged() { ! grep -qF -- "$1" "$FAKE_LOG"; }
    39	not() { ! "$@"; }
    40	check() { # check LABEL CONDITION...
    41	  local label=$1; shift
    42	  if "$@"; then pass=$((pass + 1)); else fail=$((fail + 1)); echo "FAIL [$label]: $OUT"; fi
    43	}
    44	not_grep() { ! grep -q -- "$1" "$2" 2>/dev/null; }
    45	REPORT_HOOK() { echo "mkdir -p $WORK/.harness/reports && printf '# $1 report\nstatus: done\n' > $WORK/.harness/reports/$1.md"; }

1	#!/bin/bash

    11	    PATH="$FAKE_CLAUDE:$HERE/../bin:$PATH" perl -e 'alarm($ENV{HRUN_ALARM_S} || 60);exec(@ARGV)' \

    28	# group in steps: claude dies first, the pipeline's subshells a moment later; 15 s cap)
    29	wait_no_runs() { local i=0; while [ $i -lt "${2:-150}" ] && [ -n "$(live_runs "$1")" ]; do sleep 0.1; i=$((i + 1)); done; }

   124	unset HARNESS_HL_MAX_S

   127	hsetup

   129	check "harness-run: refuses non-worker" [ "$RC" -ne 0 ]

1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# Headless background runs: harness ask starts harness-run detached in the background. Run: /bin/bash tests/headless-bg.test.sh
     3	set -u
     4	. "$(dirname "$0")/harness-lib.sh"
     5	FAKE_CLAUDE="$HERE/fake-claude"
     6	RUNPIDS=$(mktemp)
     7	trap 'for p in $(cat "$RUNPIDS" 2>/dev/null); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null; done; rm -f "$RUNPIDS"; cd / && for d in $WORKS; do rm -rf "$d"; done' EXIT
     8	
     9	# nrun ARGS... -> OUT, RC
    10	nrun() {
    11	  OUT=$(env -u HARNESS_ROLE \
    12	    HARNESS_POLL_SEC=0.2 HARNESS_HL_START_S=10 \
    13	    PATH="$FAKE_CLAUDE:$HERE/../bin:$PATH" perl -e 'alarm($ENV{HRUN_ALARM_S} || 60);exec(@ARGV)' \
    14	    /bin/bash "$HARNESS" "$@" 2>&1)
    15	  RC=$?
    16	}
    17	bsetup() {
    18	  setup
    19	  export FAKE_CLAUDE_MODE=success
    20	  export FAKE_REPORT_CMD="mkdir -p $WORK/.harness/reports && printf '# analyst report\nstatus: done\n' > $WORK/.harness/reports/analyst.md"
    21	}
    22	jqt() { jq -e "$@" >/dev/null; }
    23	# live_runs RID — pids whose command line carries this run id (empty RID matches nothing)
    24	live_runs() { [ -n "${1:-}" ] || return 0; pgrep -f "harness-run analyst $1 "; }
    25	wait_no_runs() { local i=0; while [ $i -lt "${2:-150}" ] && [ -n "$(live_runs "$1")" ]; do sleep 0.1; i=$((i + 1)); done; }
    26	# note_run — remember the runner of the current ask for the EXIT trap; sets RID RPID
    27	note_run() {
    28	  local i=0
    29	  while [ $i -lt 100 ] && [ ! -s .harness/asks/analyst.pid ]; do sleep 0.1; i=$((i + 1)); done
    30	  RID=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' .harness/asks/analyst.pid 2>/dev/null); RPID=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $2 }' .harness/asks/analyst.pid 2>/dev/null)
    31	  [ -z "$RPID" ] || echo "$RPID" >> "$RUNPIDS"
    32	}
    33	
    34	# 1. bg success
    35	bsetup
    36	nrun ask analyst "q1"
    37	check "bg success: rc 0" [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]
    38	check "bg success: report printed" grep -q "analyst report" <<<"$OUT"
    39	check "bg success: .stream written" grep -q "^[^ ]* .*\.jsonl$" .harness/asks/analyst.stream
    40	check "bg success: exit.json rc 0" jqt '.rc == 0' .harness/asks/analyst.exit.json
    41	check "bg success: runner log kept under .harness" [ -e .harness/asks/analyst.runner.log ]
    42	nrun status
    43	check "status after a run: idle" grep -Eq "^analyst +idle +hl" <<<"$OUT"
    44	
    45	# 2. detachment + 3. environment
    46	bsetup
    47	export FAKE_CLAUDE_MODE=slow30 FAKE_ENV_DUMP="$WORK/env.dump"
    48	MYPG=$(ps -o pgid= -p $$ | tr -d ' ')
    49	( env -u HARNESS_ROLE CLAUDECODE=1 CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT=conductor CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT=cli \
    50	    HARNESS_POLL_SEC=0.2 \
    51	    PATH="$FAKE_CLAUDE:$HERE/../bin:$PATH" /bin/bash "$HARNESS" ask analyst "q2" >"$WORK/ask.out" 2>&1 ) &
    52	ASKPID=$!
    53	note_run
    54	check "detached: runner pid known" [ -n "$RPID" ]
    55	PP=$(ps -o ppid= -p "$RPID" | tr -d ' '); PG=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$RPID" | tr -d ' ')
    56	check "detached: runner ppid is 1" [ "$PP" = 1 ]
    57	ok=0; [ -n "$PG" ] && [ "$PG" != "$MYPG" ] && ok=1
    58	check "detached: runner pgid differs from the test shell" [ "$ok" = 1 ]
    59	check "detached: runner leads its own session (pgid == pid)" [ "$PG" = "$RPID" ]
    60	echo "detach evidence: runner pid $RPID ppid $PP pgid $PG (test shell pgid $MYPG)" >&2
    61	wait "$ASKPID"
    62	check "detached: ask rc 0" [ "$?" -eq 0 ]
    63	OUT=$(cat "$WORK/ask.out")
    64	check "env: dump written" [ -s "$WORK/env.dump" ]
    65	check "env: no CLAUDECODE" not_grep "^CLAUDECODE=" "$WORK/env.dump"
    66	check "env: no CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT" not_grep "^CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT=" "$WORK/env.dump"
    67	check "env: no CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT" not_grep "^CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT=" "$WORK/env.dump"
    68	check "env: HARNESS_ROLE=worker" grep -qx "HARNESS_ROLE=worker" "$WORK/env.dump"
    69	check "env: PATH passes through" grep -q "^PATH=" "$WORK/env.dump"
    70	unset FAKE_ENV_DUMP
    71	
    72	# 6. status while running + 7. close refused / --force kills
    73	bsetup
    74	export FAKE_CLAUDE_MODE=hang

    77	note_run

    80	nrun close analyst

    82	check "close refused: run still alive" [ -n "$(live_runs "$RID")" ]
    83	nrun close analyst --force
    84	check "close --force rc 0" [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]
    85	wait_no_runs "$RID"
    86	check "close --force: no run left" [ -z "$(live_runs "$RID")" ]
    87	check "close --force: exit.json killed signal" jqt '.killed == "signal"' .harness/asks/analyst.exit.json
    88	nrun status

    90	check "close --force logged" grep -q '"event":"close".*"reason":"force_kill"' .harness/progress.jsonl
    91	
    92	# 8. an interrupted ask leaves the run alive; a later report collects it
    93	bsetup
    94	export FAKE_CLAUDE_MODE=slow40
    95	env -u HARNESS_ROLE HARNESS_POLL_SEC=0.2 \
    96	    PATH="$FAKE_CLAUDE:$HERE/../bin:$PATH" /bin/bash "$HARNESS" ask analyst "q8" >"$WORK/ask.out" 2>&1 &
    97	ASKPID=$!   # the harness ask itself (no wrapper subshell): TERM reaches it
    98	note_run
    99	kill -TERM "$ASKPID" 2>/dev/null; wait "$ASKPID" 2>/dev/null
   100	check "interrupted: the ask died before collecting" not_grep "analyst report" "$WORK/ask.out"
   101	check "interrupted: run survives the ask" [ -n "$(live_runs "$RID")" ]
   102	i=0; while [ $i -lt 100 ] && [ ! -f .harness/asks/analyst.exit.json ]; do sleep 0.1; i=$((i + 1)); done
   103	nrun report analyst
   104	check "interrupted: report collects it" grep -q "analyst report" <<<"$OUT"
   105	check "interrupted: report rc 0" [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]
   106	
   107	tty_run() {
   108	  env -u HARNESS_ROLE NO_COLOR=1 \
   109	    HARNESS_POLL_SEC=0.2 HARNESS_HL_START_S=10 \
   110	    PATH="$FAKE_CLAUDE:$HERE/../bin:$PATH" perl -e 'alarm($ENV{HRUN_ALARM_S} || 60);exec(@ARGV)' \
   111	    script -q /dev/null /bin/bash "$HARNESS" "$@" >"$WORK/tty.out" 2>&1 </dev/null
   112	  RC=$?
   113	  OUT=$(tr -d '\r' <"$WORK/tty.out")
   114	}
   115	
   116	# no-perl fallback launcher still runs the ask
   117	bsetup
   118	HARNESS_HL_NO_PERL=1 nrun ask analyst "q12"
   119	check "no perl: rc 0" [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]
   120	check "no perl: report printed" grep -q "analyst report" <<<"$OUT"
   121	
   122	# 13. harness wait: 0 after completion, 4 on timeout, 3 when the runner is SIGKILLed; it never collects
   123	bsetup
   124	nrun ask analyst "q13a"
   125	check "wait: setup ask ok" [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]
   126	nrun wait analyst
   127	check "wait done: rc 0" [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]
   128	check "wait done: one line, collect hint" bash -c '[ "$1" = "done; collect: harness report analyst" ]' _ "$OUT"
   129	nrun wait analyst
   130	check "wait is idempotent: rc 0 again" [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]
   131	check "wait does not collect (report untouched)" [ -f .harness/reports/analyst.md ]
   132	nrun wait nosuchthing
   133	check "wait: unknown target rc 1" [ "$RC" -eq 1 ]
   134	bsetup
   135	nrun wait analyst
   136	check "wait: no ask rc 3" [ "$RC" -eq 3 ]
   137	export FAKE_CLAUDE_MODE=slow60
   138	nrun ask analyst "q13b" --timeout 1000
   139	check "wait: slow ask left running (4)" [ "$RC" -eq 4 ]
   140	note_run
   141	nrun wait analyst --timeout 500
   142	check "wait --timeout 500: rc 4 while running" [ "$RC" -eq 4 ]
   143	check "wait timeout names the way on" grep -q "still running" <<<"$OUT"
   144	nrun report analyst
   145	check "report while running: exit 4, says how to wait" bash -c '[ "$1" = 4 ] && grep -q "still running (.*s); harness wait analyst blocks until done" <<<"$2"' _ "$RC" "$OUT"
   146	nrun wait analyst
   147	check "wait blocks until the run ends: rc 0" [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]
   148	wait_no_runs "$RID"
   149	bsetup
   150	export FAKE_CLAUDE_MODE=hang
   151	nrun ask analyst "q13c" --timeout 1000
   152	check "wait kill: hung ask left running (4)" [ "$RC" -eq 4 ]
   153	note_run
   154	kill -KILL "$RPID" 2>/dev/null

   158	for p in $(cat "$FAKE_DIR/claude.pids" 2>/dev/null); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null; done

1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# Headless implementer (decision 0009): exit 2 on denials, verify exit map,
     3	# lifecycle. bin/harness ask against tests/fake-claude.
     4	# Run: /bin/bash tests/headless-implementer.test.sh
     5	set -u
     6	. "$(dirname "$0")/harness-lib.sh"
     7	FAKE_CLAUDE="$HERE/fake-claude"
     8	
     9	hrun() {
    10	  OUT=$(HARNESS_POLL_SEC=0.2 HARNESS_HL_START_S=5 \
    11	    PATH="$FAKE_CLAUDE:$HERE/../bin:$PATH" perl -e 'alarm($ENV{HRUN_ALARM_S} || 60);exec(@ARGV)' \
    12	    env -u HARNESS_ROLE /bin/bash "$HARNESS" "$@" 2>&1)
    13	  RC=$?
    14	}
    15	jqt() { jq -e "$@" >/dev/null; }
    16	lastprog() { tail -n 1 .harness/progress.jsonl 2>/dev/null; }
    17	# isetup — implementer (and analyst) headless; the fake claude writes an implementer report
    18	isetup() {
    19	  setup
    20	  :
    21	  export FAKE_CLAUDE_MODE=success
    22	  unset FAKE_CLAUDE_DENY
    23	  export FAKE_REPORT_CMD="mkdir -p $WORK/.harness/reports && printf '# implementer report\nstatus: done\n' > $WORK/.harness/reports/implementer.md"
    24	}
    25	
    26	# 1. permission pin + denial parsing + exit 2
    27	isetup
    28	hrun ask implementer "q"
    29	check "pin: rc 0" [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]
    30	check "pin: implementer argv has --permission-mode auto" logged "--permission-mode auto"
    31	check "pin: implementer argv has --permission-prompts none" logged "--permission-prompts none"
    32	isetup
    33	hrun ask analyst "q"
    34	check "pin: analyst argv unchanged" not_logged "--permission-mode"
    35	
    36	isetup; export FAKE_CLAUDE_MODE=noreport FAKE_CLAUDE_DENY=1
    37	hrun ask implementer "q"
    38	check "denied, no report: rc 2" [ "$RC" -eq 2 ]
    39	check "denied, no report: names tool and first line" grep -q 'Bash: rm -rf /tmp/x (safetyCheck)' <<<"$OUT"
    40	check "denied, no report: only first line of the input" not_grep "second line" <(printf '%s' "$OUT")
    41	check "denied, no report: re-ask hint" grep -q 'Re-ask' <<<"$OUT"

    44	
    45	isetup; export FAKE_CLAUDE_DENY=1
    46	hrun ask implementer "q"

    48	check "denied + report: report printed" grep -q "implementer report" <<<"$OUT"

    50	
    51	isetup; export FAKE_CLAUDE_MODE=noreport FAKE_CLAUDE_DENY=1
    52	hrun ask analyst "q"
    53	check "denied, no report: analyst (all headless roles) rc 2" [ "$RC" -eq 2 ]
    54
