376	   198	# hl_clock_gap <prev-epoch> <now-epoch> <poll-s> — print the seconds to add to a deadline when the
377	   199	# wall clock jumped between two polls (laptop sleep): a gap above 5x the poll interval + 5 s counts as a
378	   200	# suspend; 0 otherwise. Pure arithmetic, so tests inject the timestamps.
379	   201	hl_clock_gap() {
380	   202	  awk -v p="$1" -v n="$2" -v i="${3:-2}" 'BEGIN { g = n - p; if (g > 5 * i + 5) printf "%d\n", g; else print 0 }'
381	   203	}
382	   204	# hl_deadline_bump <prev> <now> <poll> <deadline> [<cap-s> <deadline0>] — print the (possibly extended) deadline;
383	   205	# one stderr line when it moved. With a cap, one bump is at most <cap-s> and all bumps together at most
384	   206	# 2x<cap-s> over <deadline0> (the deadline before any bump), so a bogus clock jump cannot keep an ask alive forever.
385	   207	hl_deadline_bump() {
386	   208	  local g=0 cap=${5:-} d0=${6:-$4} room
387	   209	  g=$(hl_clock_gap "$1" "$2" "$3")
388	   210	  case "$cap" in ''|*[!0-9]*) cap=0 ;; esac
389	   211	  if [ "$g" -gt 0 ] && [ "$cap" -gt 0 ]; then
390	   212	    [ "$g" -le "$cap" ] || g=$cap
391	   213	    room=$((2 * cap - ($4 - d0)))
392	   214	    [ "$room" -gt 0 ] || room=0
393	   215	    [ "$g" -le "$room" ] || g=$room
394	   216	  fi
395	   217	  if [ "$g" -gt 0 ]; then
396	   218	    echo "harness: clock jumped ${g}s (sleep?); deadline extended" >&2
397	   219	    echo $(($4 + g))
398	   220	  else
399	   221	    echo "$4"
400	   222	  fi
401	   223	}

403	   225	# ask_headless <role> <text> <timeout-ms> <keep> — the whole headless ask; always exits
404	   226	ask_headless() {
405	   227	  local role=$1 text=$2 timeout=$3 keep=$4 id start retried resume="" sid max_s ctxb="" report="$REPORT_DIR/$1.md"
406	   228	  local a="$ASK_DIR/$role" now prev deadline dl0 poll=${HARNESS_POLL_SEC:-2} start_s=${HARNESS_HL_START_S:-15} s0 g
407	   229	  mkdir -p "$ASK_DIR" "$REPORT_DIR" "$LOG_DIR"
408	   230	  if hl_alive "$role"; then

410	   232	    exit 4
411	   233	  fi
412	   234	  rm -f "$a.run"
413	   235	  if [ "$keep" = 1 ]; then
414	   236	    sid=$(sed -n 1p "$a.session" 2>/dev/null)

416	   238	      resume=$sid
417	   239	      ctxb=$(jq -r '.ctx // empty' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
418	   240	    elif sid=$(hl_last_session "$role") && [ "$sid" = closed ]; then
419	   241	      echo "harness: note: $role was closed after its last successful run; no session to resume — running fresh"
420	   242	    elif [ -n "$sid" ]; then
421	   243	      # the previous run died before it reported a session: fall back to the last successful one
422	   244	      resume=$sid
423	   245	      echo "harness: note: the previous run recorded no session; resuming the last successful one from progress.jsonl (${sid:0:8})"
424	   246	    else
425	   247	      echo "harness: note: no previous session for $role — running fresh"
426	   248	    fi
427	   249	  fi
428	   250	  # a session file left by an earlier run must never be mistaken for this run's
429	   251	  rm -f "$a.session"
430	   252	  rm -f "$report"

432	   254	  printf '%s %s\n' "$id" "$start" > "$a.current"
433	   255	  rm -f "$a.exit.json" "$a.pid"
434	   256	  if [ "$role" = implementer ]; then verify_tool baseline implementer 2>/dev/null || rm -f .harness/verify/implementer.json; fi
435	   257	  max_s=$(hl_max_s "$role")
436	   258	  printf '%s\n' "$text" > "$a.prompt"
437	   259	  hl_launch "$role" "$id" "$resume" "$max_s" "$ctxb" "$start_s" "$poll"
438	   260	  deadline=$((start + (timeout + 999) / 1000))
439	   261	  # no --timeout: wait for the run to end (its cap plus a margin for the watchdog kill and exit.json), so a
440	   262	  # background `harness ask` returns exactly when the run does and the conductor's task notification fires
441	   263	  [ "${ASK_TIMEOUT_SET:-0}" = 1 ] || deadline=$((start + max_s + 30))
442	   264	  prev=$(date +%s); dl0=$deadline
443	   265	  retried=0

445	   267	    if hl_done "$role" "$id"; then
446	   268	      if [ "$retried" = 0 ] && hl_resume_missing "$role"; then
447	   269	        # the session is gone: one fresh run in the same ask; the dead sid must not stay the resume target
448	   270	        retried=1
449	   271	        echo "harness: resume of ${resume:0:8} failed, running fresh" >&2
450	   272	        resume=""; ctxb=""
451	   273	        hl_launch "$role" "$id" "" "$max_s" "" "$start_s" "$poll"
452	   274	        continue
453	   275	      fi
454	   276	      hl_collect "$role"
455	   277	    fi
456	   278	    if ! hl_alive "$role"; then
457	   279	      # the runner may still be writing exit.json (jq, mv) as its pid disappears: give it ~3 s
458	   280	      g=0; while [ "$g" -lt 30 ] && ! hl_done "$role" "$id"; do sleep 0.1; g=$((g + 1)); done
459	   281	      if hl_done "$role" "$id"; then continue; fi
460	   282	      sid=$(sed -n 1p "$a.session" 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-8)
461	   283	      if [ -n "$sid" ]; then
462	   284	        echo "harness: $role's run is gone without a result (killed?); --keep resumes session $sid"
463	   285	      else
464	   286	        echo "harness: $role's run is gone without a result (killed?); it recorded no session (--keep resumes the last successful one, if any)"
465	   287	      fi
466	   288	      exit 3
467	   289	    fi
468	   290	    now=$(date +%s)
469	   291	    deadline=$(hl_deadline_bump "$prev" "$now" "$poll" "$deadline" "$max_s" "$dl0"); prev=$now
470	   292	    if [ "$now" -ge "$deadline" ]; then
471	   293	      if [ "$role" = implementer ] && [ -f "$report.pending" ]; then

473	   295	        echo "harness: $role is still verifying (Stop hook running, $(cat .harness/verify/implementer.attempts 2>/dev/null || echo 0) failed attempt(s) so far, $((now - start))s); collect: harness report $role; stop: harness close $role --force" >&2
474	   296	        exit 4
475	   297	      fi
476	   298	      echo "harness: $role is still running (pid $(hl_pid "$role"), $((now - start))s); collect: harness report $role; stop: harness close $role --force" >&2
477	   299	      exit 4
478	   300	    fi
479	   301	    sleep "$poll"
480	   302	  done
481	   303	}

632	   454	  fi

1	# harness-lane.sh — per-issue work folders (git worktrees): `harness lane` (issue #63).
     2	# Sourced eagerly by bin/harness: definitions only. Uses die/usage/cmd_init/hl_alive/AGENTS from it.
     3	
     4	# lane_primary — path of the primary worktree (first entry of git's list), from any folder
     5	lane_primary() { git worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1s/^worktree //p'; }
     6	
     7	# lane_in_primary — 0 when the cwd is the primary worktree of a git repo
     8	lane_in_primary() {
     9	  local g c
    10	  g=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir 2>/dev/null) || return 1
    11	  c=$(cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || return 1
    12	  [ "$(cd "$g" && pwd -P)" = "$c" ]
    13	}
    14	
    15	# lane_rows — "path<TAB>branch" for every non-primary worktree (path canonical, pwd -P)
    16	lane_rows() {
    17	  local p b
    18	  git worktree list --porcelain | awk -v RS= -F'\n' 'NR > 1 { p = b = ""
    19	    for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) { if ($i ~ /^worktree /) p = substr($i, 10); if ($i ~ /^branch /) b = substr($i, 19) }
    20	    print p "\t" b }' | while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r p b; do
    21	    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(cd "$p" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P || echo "$p")" "$b"
    22	  done
    23	}

    25	# lane_running <path> — a worker of this folder is running
    26	lane_running() {
    27	  local a
    28	  for a in $AGENTS; do ( cd "$1" 2>/dev/null && hl_alive "$a" ) && return 0; done
    29	  return 1
    30	}

    32	# lane_pr <branch> — PR state (OPEN|MERGED|CLOSED) or empty (no PR, no gh)
    33	lane_pr() { command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && gh pr view "$1" --json state -q .state 2>/dev/null; }

    35	# lane_prinfo <branch> — "STATE<TAB>headRefOid" of the branch's PR, or empty (no PR, no gh)

    40	# lane_find <issue#|path> — "path<TAB>branch" of a work folder (issue numbers match lane branches only)
    41	lane_find() {
    42	  local t=$1 r
    43	  [ ! -d "$t" ] || t=$(cd "$t" && pwd -P)
    44	  r=$(lane_rows | awk -F'\t' -v t="$t" '$1 == t || (t ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 ~ ("^(feat|fix|docs)/" t "-")) { print; exit }')
    45	  [ -n "$r" ] && printf '%s\n' "$r"
    46	}

    48	lane_ls() {
    49	  local p b n s w
    50	  lane_rows | while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r p b; do
    51	    b=${b#refs/heads/}; n=${b#*/}; n=${n%%-*}
    52	    s=$(lane_pr "$b"); w=""
    53	    ! lane_running "$p" || w=" running"
    54	    printf '#%s  %s  %s  PR:%s%s\n' "$n" "$b" "$p" "${s:--}" "$w"

    58	# lane_copy <primary> <dir> — copy the files named in .claude/harness.json "lane_copy" (relative, no ..) from the primary
    59	lane_copy() {
    60	  local f
    61	  jq -r '.lane_copy[]? | strings' "$1/.claude/harness.json" 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r f; do
    62	    case "/$f/" in /*//*|*/../*|*/./*) f="" ;; esac
    63	    case "$f" in /*|"") echo "harness lane: lane_copy: skipping an unsafe path" >&2; continue ;; esac
    64	    [ -f "$1/$f" ] || { echo "harness lane: lane_copy: $f is missing in the primary folder; skipped" >&2; continue; }
    65	    [ ! -e "$2/$f" ] || continue
    66	    case "$f" in */*) mkdir -p "$2/${f%/*}" 2>/dev/null ;; esac
    67	    cp -p "$1/$f" "$2/$f" || echo "harness lane: lane_copy: could not copy $f" >&2
    68	  done
    69	}

    71	# lane_ignored_diff <primary> <dir> — ignored files of the work folder that differ from (or are missing in) the primary
    72	lane_ignored_diff() {
    73	  git -C "$2" ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard \
    74	    | grep -Ev '^\.harness/|^\.claude/settings\.local\.json$|(^|/)(node_modules|dist|build|\.venv|target|\.next|coverage|__pycache__)/' \
    75	    | while IFS= read -r f; do
    76	        if [ ! -e "$1/$f" ]; then echo "$f only in the work folder"
    77	        elif ! cmp -s "$1/$f" "$2/$f"; then echo "$f differs from the original folder"; fi
    78	      done
    79	}

    81	lane_new() {
    82	  [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ] || die "harness lane is for the conductor"
    83	  local issue="" slug="" type=feat prim dir base branch hint setup shared=""
    84	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    85	    case "$1" in
    86	      --type) type=${2:-}; shift ;;
    87	      -*) usage ;;
    88	      *) if [ -z "$issue" ]; then issue=$1; elif [ -z "$slug" ]; then slug=$1; else usage; fi ;;
    89	    esac
    90	    shift
    91	  done
    92	  digits_only "$issue" || usage
    93	  case "$type" in feat|fix|docs) ;; *) die "--type must be feat, fix or docs" ;; esac
    94	  prim=$(lane_primary); [ -n "$prim" ] || die "not a git repository"
    95	  dir=${prim%/*}/${prim##*/}-$issue
    96	  if [ -z "$slug" ]; then
    97	    slug=$(gh issue view "$issue" --json title -q .title 2>/dev/null | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' \
    98	      | sed -E 's/[^a-z0-9]+/-/g; s/^-+//; s/-+$//' | cut -c1-30 | sed -E 's/-+$//')
    99	    [ -n "$slug" ] || slug=task
   100	  fi
   101	  git fetch origin -q 2>/dev/null || echo "harness lane: git fetch origin failed; using the local refs" >&2
   102	  base=$(git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null) || base=origin/main
   103	  if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
   104	    lane_rows | awk -F'\t' -v d="$(cd "$dir" && pwd -P)" '$1 == d { f = 1 } END { exit !f }' \
   105	      || die "$dir exists but is not a work folder of this repo (git worktree list); move it away or pick another issue"
   106	    branch=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)
   107	    echo "harness lane: $dir exists; reusing it ($branch)"
   108	  else
   109	    branch=$type/$issue-$slug
   110	    if git show-ref --verify -q "refs/heads/$branch"; then
   111	      git worktree add "$dir" "$branch" >&2 || die "git worktree add failed"
   112	      echo "harness lane: branch $branch exists; reusing it"
   113	    else
   114	      git worktree add "$dir" -b "$branch" "$base" >&2 || die "git worktree add failed"
   115	    fi
   116	  fi
   117	  # same mode as the primary: shared only when its committed settings already name the conductor
   118	  ! jq -e '.agent == "conductor"' "$prim/.claude/settings.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || shared=--shared
   119	  ( cd "$dir" && cmd_init $shared ) || echo "harness lane: harness init failed in $dir" >&2
   120	  lane_copy "$prim" "$dir"
   121	  setup=$(jq -r '.lane_setup // empty' "$dir/.claude/harness.json" 2>/dev/null)
   122	  if [ -n "$setup" ]; then
   123	    ( cd "$dir" && sh -c "$setup" ) || echo "harness lane: lane_setup failed in $dir (folder kept)" >&2
   124	  fi
   125	  echo "$dir"
   126	}

   128	lane_rm() {
   129	  [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ] || die "harness lane is for the conductor"
   130	  local force="" t="" row p b info="" st="" oid="" head n tab prim base lost
   131	  tab=$(printf '\t')
   132	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
   133	    case "$1" in --force) force=1 ;; -*) usage ;; *) [ -z "$t" ] || usage; t=$1 ;; esac
   134	    shift
   135	  done
   136	  [ -n "$t" ] || usage
   137	  row=$(lane_find "$t") || die "no work folder for '$t' (harness lane ls)"
   138	  p=${row%%"$tab"*}; b=${row#*"$tab"}; b=${b#refs/heads/}
   139	  prim=$(lane_primary)
   140	  lane_running "$p" && die "a worker is running in $p; wait for it or harness -C $p close <role>"
   141	  if [ -n "$b" ]; then
   142	    info=$(lane_prinfo "$b"); st=${info%%"$tab"*}
   143	    case "$info" in *"$tab"*) oid=${info#*"$tab"} ;; esac
   144	  elif [ -z "$force" ]; then
   145	    die "work folder $p is on a detached HEAD; check out a branch first (or --force)"
   146	  fi
   147	  head=$(git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)
   148	  if [ -z "$force" ]; then
   149	    case "$st" in MERGED|CLOSED) ;; *) die "PR of $b is '${st:-none}', not merged or closed; merge it first (or --force)" ;; esac
   150	    [ -n "$oid" ] && [ "$head" = "$oid" ] \
   151	      || die "$b has commits that are not in its PR (local ${head:0:8}, PR ${oid:0:8}); push or rescue them first (or --force)"
   152	    lost=$(lane_ignored_diff "$prim" "$p")
   153	    [ -z "$lost" ] || die "ignored files would be lost in $p (--force to remove anyway):
   154	$lost"
   155	  else
   156	    if [ -n "$oid" ] && git -C "$p" cat-file -e "$oid^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then base=$oid
   157	    else base=$(git -C "$p" symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo origin/main); fi
   158	    n=$(git -C "$p" rev-list --count "$base..HEAD" 2>/dev/null)
   159	    echo "harness lane: --force; ${b:-detached HEAD} has ${n:-?} commit(s) not in a PR; uncommitted and ignored files in $p are discarded" >&2
   160	  fi
   161	  cd "$prim" || die "cannot enter the primary worktree"
   162	  git worktree remove ${force:+--force} "$p" || die "git worktree remove failed for $p (uncommitted changes? --force)"
   163	  [ -z "$b" ] || git branch -D "$b" >/dev/null || echo "harness lane: could not delete branch $b" >&2
   164	  # a merged PR's branch is done (unless someone pushed to it after the merge); a closed PR keeps its remote branch
   165	  if [ "$st" = MERGED ] && [ -n "$oid" ] && git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   166	    git push --force-with-lease="$b:$oid" origin --delete "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
   167	      || echo "harness lane: kept origin/$b (it has commits after the merged PR head, or the delete failed)" >&2
   168	  fi
   169	  echo "removed $p${b:+ and branch $b}"
   170	}
   171	
   172	cmd_lane() {
   173	  case "${1:-}" in
   174	    ls) lane_ls ;;
   175	    rm) shift; lane_rm "$@" ;;
   176	    *) lane_new "$@" ;;
   177	  esac
   178	}
     1	# harness-headless.sh — the headless runner glue (decisions 0007, 0011): hl_*, ask/report/close_headless.
     2	# Sourced eagerly by bin/harness (see the loader there): definitions only, no side effects.
     3	# Shared helpers (die, ...) stay in bin/harness and resolve at call time.
     4	
     5	# --- headless runner (decision 0007) --------------------------------------------------------------
     6	# `harness ask` writes the instruction to a file and starts `harness-run` (claude -p, stream-json)
     7	# detached in the background. Completion = the run's .harness/asks/<role>.exit.json carrying this
     8	# ask-id. A human watches a run with `harness watch <role>` in any terminal.
     9	
    10	# env a background run must not inherit: the conductor's Claude identity (a denylist, not
    11	# env -i: API keys, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, proxies, PATH, HOME and TMPDIR pass through)
    12	HL_ENV_STRIP="-u CLAUDECODE -u CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT -u CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID -u CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION"
    13	HL_ENV_STRIP="$HL_ENV_STRIP -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED -u CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET -u CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_TOKEN -u CLAUDE_PID -u CLAUDE_EFFORT -u CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH"
    14	
    15	# hl_alive <role> — a harness-run for the role is running (pid file, live harness-run process)
    16	hl_alive() {
    17	  local f="$ASK_DIR/$1.pid" id pid
    18	  [ -f "$f" ] || return 1
    19	  read -r id pid _ < "$f"
    20	  digits_only "${pid:-}" && kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    21	  ps -p "$pid" -o command= 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'harness-run'
    22	}
    23	# hl_last_session <role> — session id of the role's latest *successful* headless run (progress
    24	# line with result "success" and a session). Old rows with an ask_id (the removed --worktree asks)
    25	# are ignored, as in last_ask_record. A close event of the role is a boundary: when one came after the last such run, print "closed" instead (no session id looks like that).
    26	hl_last_session() {
    27	  [ -f "$JSONL" ] || return 1
    28	  tail -n 200 "$JSONL" 2>/dev/null \
    29	    | jq -R -n -r --arg r "$1" '
    30	        reduce (inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")) as $e ({sid: "", closed: false};
    31	          if $e.event == "close" then (if $e.role == $r and ($e.ask_id // "") == "" then {sid: "", closed: true} else . end)
    32	          elif ($e.ask_id // "") != "" then .
    33	          elif $e.agent == $r and $e.runner == "headless" and $e.result == "success" and (($e.session // "") != "") then {sid: $e.session, closed: false}
    34	          else . end)
    35	        | if .sid != "" then .sid elif .closed then "closed" else empty end' 2>/dev/null \
    36	    | grep .
    37	}
    38	hl_pid() { awk 'NR == 1 { print $2 }' "$ASK_DIR/$1.pid" 2>/dev/null; }
    39	# hl_done <role> <ask-id> — exit.json exists for that ask
    40	hl_done() { grep -q "\"ask_id\":\"$2\"" "$ASK_DIR/$1.exit.json" 2>/dev/null; }
    41	
    42	# hl_progress_obj <role> <t0> — extra progress.jsonl fields of the role's last run, as one
    43	# JSON object (keys session / ctx_after are consumed by the caller)
    44	hl_progress_obj() {
    45	  local role=$1 t0=${2:-} ej="$ASK_DIR/$1.exit.json" id resume=false
    46	  id=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" 2>/dev/null)
    47	  [ -z "$(sed -n 's/^resume=//p' "$ASK_DIR/$role.run" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" ] || resume=true
    48	  if [ -f "$ej" ] && { [ -z "$id" ] || hl_done "$role" "$id"; }; then
    49	    jq -c --argjson resume "$resume" --argjson t0 "$(num_or_null "$t0")" '
    50	      {runner: "headless", cost_usd: (.cost_usd // null), turns: (.num_turns // null), result: (.result // null),
    51	       denials: (.denials // null), stream_log: (.stream_log // null), resume: $resume,
    52	       startup_s: (if (.t_init | type) == "number" and $t0 != null then (.t_init - $t0) else null end),
    53	       session: (.session_id // ""), ctx_after: (.ctx // "")}' "$ej" 2>/dev/null && return 0
    54	  fi
    55	  jq -n -c --argjson resume "$resume" '{runner: "headless", resume: $resume, session: "", ctx_after: ""}'
    56	}

    58	# hl_status_line <role> status|progress — one line for `harness status` / progress.md. Keyed on the
    59	# run state
    60	hl_status_line() {
    61	  local role=$1 mode=$2 st el ctx
    62	  if hl_alive "$role"; then st=running
    63	  elif [ -f "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" ]; then st=idle
    64	  else
    65	    if [ "$mode" = status ]; then printf '%-12s %s\n' "$role" "-"; else printf '%s -' "$role"; fi
    66	    return 0
    67	  fi
    68	  ctx=$(jq -r '.ctx // empty' "$ASK_DIR/$role.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
    69	  el=""
    70	  [ "$st" != running ] || el=$(( $(date +%s) - $(awk 'NR == 1 { print $2 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) ))
    71	  if [ "$mode" = status ]; then
    72	    if [ "$st" = running ]; then printf '%-12s %-8s hl %ss\n' "$role" "$st" "$el"
    73	    else printf '%-12s %-8s hl ctx %s\n' "$role" "$st" "$(fmt_ctx "$ctx")"; fi
    74	  else
    75	    printf '%s %s ctx %s hl' "$role" "$st" "$(fmt_ctx "$ctx")"
    76	  fi
    77	}

    79	# hl_collect <role> — a finished run (exit.json present): print the report or explain, exit.
    80	# First match wins (spec §3). Never returns.
    81	hl_collect() {
    82	  local role=$1 ej="$ASK_DIR/$1.exit.json" report="$REPORT_DIR/$1.md" cur="$ASK_DIR/$1.current"
    83	  local rc res iserr killed sid tinit perm ejc denied
    84	  ejc=$(cat "$ej" 2>/dev/null)   # one read
    85	  rc=$(jq -r '.rc // empty' <<<"$ejc" 2>/dev/null); res=$(jq -r '.result // empty' <<<"$ejc" 2>/dev/null)
    86	  iserr=$(jq -r '.is_error // false' <<<"$ejc" 2>/dev/null); killed=$(jq -r '.killed // empty' <<<"$ejc" 2>/dev/null)
    87	  sid=$(jq -r '(.session_id // "") | .[0:8]' <<<"$ejc" 2>/dev/null); tinit=$(jq -r '.t_init // empty' <<<"$ejc" 2>/dev/null)
    88	  perm=$(jq -r '.perm // empty' <<<"$ejc" 2>/dev/null)
    89	  if [ -n "$perm" ] && [ "$perm" != auto ]; then
    90	    echo "harness: warning: $role ran with permission mode '$perm', not auto; tools may have been denied (see harness watch)" >&2
    91	  fi
    92	  denied=$(jq -r '(.denied // [])[] | "  - \(.tool): \(.input)\(if (.reason // "") != "" then " (" + .reason + ")" else "" end)"' <<<"$ejc" 2>/dev/null)
    93	  restore_interrupted "$role" "$report"
    94	  if [ -f "$report" ] && { [ ! -f "$cur" ] || [ ! "$report" -ot "$cur" ]; }; then
    95	    [ -z "$denied" ] || printf 'harness: note: %s denied tool call(s):\n%s\n' "$(grep -c . <<<"$denied")" "$denied" >&2
    96	    if { [ -n "$rc" ] && [ "$rc" != 0 ]; } || [ "$iserr" = true ]; then
    97	      echo "harness: note: $role's run ended with ${res:-no result} (rc ${rc:-?}) but wrote a report" >&2
    98	    fi
    99	    finish_report "$role" "$report"
   100	  fi
   101	  if [ "$res" = error_max_turns ]; then
   102	    echo "harness: $role stopped at the max-turns limit without a report; continue with: harness ask $role '...' --keep"
   103	    hl_view_tail "$role" 30; exit 3
   104	  fi
   105	  if [ -n "$killed" ]; then
   106	    echo "harness: $role's run was killed ($killed); --keep resumes session ${sid:-?}"
   107	    exit 3
   108	  fi
   109	  if [ "$rc" = 127 ] || [ -z "$tinit" ]; then
   110	    echo "harness: $role's claude did not start (rc ${rc:-?}):" >&2
   111	    tail -n 20 "$ASK_DIR/$role.err" 2>/dev/null >&2
   112	    exit 1
   113	  fi
   114	  if [ "$iserr" = true ] || [ -n "$res" -a "$res" != success ] || { [ -n "$rc" ] && [ "$rc" != 0 ]; }; then
   115	    echo "harness: $role's worker ended with ${res:-error} (rc ${rc:-?}) and wrote no report"
   116	    tail -n 20 "$ASK_DIR/$role.err" 2>/dev/null
   117	    hl_view_tail "$role" 30; exit 3
   118	  fi
   119	  # permissions blocked the worker and it wrote nothing: there is no answer to relay (exit 2), only when the run ended without errors
   120	  if [ -n "$denied" ] && [ -z "$killed" ] && [ -n "$tinit" ]; then
   121	    printf 'harness: %s was denied %s tool call(s) and wrote no report; nothing to answer. Re-ask with a changed brief:\n%s\n' \
   122	      "$role" "$(grep -c . <<<"$denied")" "$denied"
   123	    hl_view_tail "$role" 30; exit 2
   124	  fi
   125	  echo "harness: $role finished without a report at $report; collect: harness report $role"
   126	  hl_view_tail "$role" 30; exit 3
   127	}
   128	# hl_view_tail <role> <n> — the last n lines the run showed: the rendered stream
   129	hl_view_tail() {
   130	  local role=$1 n=${2:-30} raw
   131	  raw=$(jq -r '.stream_log // empty' "$ASK_DIR/$role.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
   132	  [ -n "$raw" ] || raw=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $2 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.stream" 2>/dev/null)
   133	  if [ -n "$raw" ] && [ -f "$raw" ]; then harness-view < "$raw" 2>/dev/null | tail -n "$n"; fi
   134	  return 0
   135	}

   137	# hl_spawn_bg <role> <id> <root> — start harness-run detached from this process tree: a double fork
   138	# (the subshell exits at once, so the run is reparented to init and ask_finish's kill_tree never
   139	# reaches it) in a new session (no controlling tty, and a pgid kill of the caller's call misses it).
   140	# There is no setsid binary on macOS: perl does it. HARNESS_HL_NO_PERL=1 forces the fallback (tests).
   141	# Under this spawn harness-run's INT/HUP traps are inert (an async start ignores INT, nohup ignores
   142	# HUP); only TERM reaches it, which is what hl_kill sends. Intended.
   143	hl_spawn_bg() {
   144	  local role=$1 id=$2 root=$3 log
   145	  case "$ASK_DIR" in /*) log=$ASK_DIR ;; *) log=$root/$ASK_DIR ;; esac
   146	  log=$log/$role.runner.log
   147	  if [ "${HARNESS_HL_NO_PERL:-}" != 1 ] && command -v perl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   148	    ( cd "$root" && exec env $HL_ENV_STRIP HARNESS_ROLE=worker CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=160000 \
   149	        nohup perl -MPOSIX -e 'POSIX::setsid() or die "setsid: $!"; exec @ARGV or die "exec: $!"' \
   150	        harness-run "$role" "$id" "$root" </dev/null >>"$log" 2>&1 & )
   151	  else
   152	    # no perl: its own process group through job control (the session stays shared)
   153	    ( cd "$root" || exit 1; set -m
   154	      env $HL_ENV_STRIP HARNESS_ROLE=worker CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=160000 \
   155	        nohup harness-run "$role" "$id" "$root" </dev/null >>"$log" 2>&1 & )
   156	  fi
   157	}

   159	# hl_launch <role> <id> <resume> <max_s> <ctxb> <start_s> <poll> — write the run file, start
   160	# harness-run detached in the background and wait for its pid file; exits 1 when it never starts.
   161	hl_launch() {
   162	  local role=$1 id=$2 resume=$3 max_s=$4 ctxb=$5 start_s=$6 poll=$7 a="$ASK_DIR/$1" s0 root
   163	  root=$(pwd -P)
   164	  rm -f "$a.exit.json" "$a.pid"
   165	  printf 'resume=%s\nmax_s=%s\nctx_before=%s\n' "$resume" "$max_s" "$ctxb" > "$a.run"
   166	  hl_spawn_bg "$role" "$id" "$root"
   167	  # the run announces itself with its pid file
   168	  s0=$(date +%s)
   169	  until grep -q "^$id " "$a.pid" 2>/dev/null || hl_done "$role" "$id"; do
   170	    if [ $(( $(date +%s) - s0 )) -ge "$start_s" ]; then
   171	      echo "harness: $role's background run did not start in $start_s s; runner log:" >&2
   172	      tail -n 20 "$a.runner.log" >&2 2>/dev/null
   173	      exit 1
   174	    fi
   175	    sleep "$poll"
   176	  done
   177	}
   178	# hl_resume_missing <role> — the finished run was a --resume that produced no init event because
   179	# claude could not find the conversation (real claude: result-only stream, error_during_execution)
   180	hl_resume_missing() {
   181	  local role=$1 a="$ASK_DIR/$1" raw
   182	  [ -n "$(sed -n 's/^resume=//p' "$a.run" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" ] || return 1
   183	  [ -z "$(jq -r '.t_init // empty' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)" ] || return 1
   184	  raw=$(jq -r '.stream_log // empty' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)

   186	  [ -z "$raw" ] || grep -qi 'no conversation found' "$raw" 2>/dev/null
   187	}
   188	
   189	# hl_max_s <role> — the role's headless run cap in seconds: env, then config headless_max_minutes, then the default
   190	hl_max_s() {
   191	  local m=${HARNESS_HL_MAX_S:-}
   192	  digits_only "$m" && { echo "$m"; return 0; }
   193	  m=$(jq -r '.headless_max_minutes // empty' "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
   194	  digits_only "$m" && { echo $((m * 60)); return 0; }

   196	}
   197	
   198	# hl_clock_gap <prev-epoch> <now-epoch> <poll-s> — print the seconds to add to a deadline when the
   199	# wall clock jumped between two polls (laptop sleep): a gap above 5x the poll interval + 5 s counts as a
   200	# suspend; 0 otherwise. Pure arithmetic, so tests inject the timestamps.
   201	hl_clock_gap() {
   202	  awk -v p="$1" -v n="$2" -v i="${3:-2}" 'BEGIN { g = n - p; if (g > 5 * i + 5) printf "%d\n", g; else print 0 }'
   203	}
   204	# hl_deadline_bump <prev> <now> <poll> <deadline> [<cap-s> <deadline0>] — print the (possibly extended) deadline;
   205	# one stderr line when it moved. With a cap, one bump is at most <cap-s> and all bumps together at most
   206	# 2x<cap-s> over <deadline0> (the deadline before any bump), so a bogus clock jump cannot keep an ask alive forever.
   207	hl_deadline_bump() {
   208	  local g=0 cap=${5:-} d0=${6:-$4} room
   209	  g=$(hl_clock_gap "$1" "$2" "$3")
   210	  case "$cap" in ''|*[!0-9]*) cap=0 ;; esac
   211	  if [ "$g" -gt 0 ] && [ "$cap" -gt 0 ]; then
   212	    [ "$g" -le "$cap" ] || g=$cap
   213	    room=$((2 * cap - ($4 - d0)))
   214	    [ "$room" -gt 0 ] || room=0
   215	    [ "$g" -le "$room" ] || g=$room
   216	  fi
   217	  if [ "$g" -gt 0 ]; then
   218	    echo "harness: clock jumped ${g}s (sleep?); deadline extended" >&2
   219	    echo $(($4 + g))
   220	  else
   221	    echo "$4"
   222	  fi
   223	}
   224	
   225	# ask_headless <role> <text> <timeout-ms> <keep> — the whole headless ask; always exits
   226	ask_headless() {
   227	  local role=$1 text=$2 timeout=$3 keep=$4 id start retried resume="" sid max_s ctxb="" report="$REPORT_DIR/$1.md"
   228	  local a="$ASK_DIR/$role" now prev deadline dl0 poll=${HARNESS_POLL_SEC:-2} start_s=${HARNESS_HL_START_S:-15} s0 g
   229	  mkdir -p "$ASK_DIR" "$REPORT_DIR" "$LOG_DIR"
   230	  if hl_alive "$role"; then
   231	    echo "harness: $role is still running (pid $(hl_pid "$role")); nothing sent. Collect with: harness report $role; stop: harness close $role --force" >&2
   232	    exit 4
   233	  fi
   234	  rm -f "$a.run"
   235	  if [ "$keep" = 1 ]; then
   236	    sid=$(sed -n 1p "$a.session" 2>/dev/null)
   237	    if [ -n "$sid" ]; then
   238	      resume=$sid
   239	      ctxb=$(jq -r '.ctx // empty' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
   240	    elif sid=$(hl_last_session "$role") && [ "$sid" = closed ]; then
   241	      echo "harness: note: $role was closed after its last successful run; no session to resume — running fresh"
   242	    elif [ -n "$sid" ]; then
   243	      # the previous run died before it reported a session: fall back to the last successful one
   244	      resume=$sid
   245	      echo "harness: note: the previous run recorded no session; resuming the last successful one from progress.jsonl (${sid:0:8})"
   246	    else
   247	      echo "harness: note: no previous session for $role — running fresh"
   248	    fi
   249	  fi
   250	  # a session file left by an earlier run must never be mistaken for this run's
   251	  rm -f "$a.session"
   252	  rm -f "$report"
   253	  id="$(date +%s)-$$-$RANDOM"; start=$(date +%s)
   254	  printf '%s %s\n' "$id" "$start" > "$a.current"
   255	  rm -f "$a.exit.json" "$a.pid"
   256	  if [ "$role" = implementer ]; then verify_tool baseline implementer 2>/dev/null || rm -f .harness/verify/implementer.json; fi
   257	  max_s=$(hl_max_s "$role")
   258	  printf '%s\n' "$text" > "$a.prompt"
   259	  hl_launch "$role" "$id" "$resume" "$max_s" "$ctxb" "$start_s" "$poll"
   260	  deadline=$((start + (timeout + 999) / 1000))
   261	  # no --timeout: wait for the run to end (its cap plus a margin for the watchdog kill and exit.json), so a
   262	  # background `harness ask` returns exactly when the run does and the conductor's task notification fires
   263	  [ "${ASK_TIMEOUT_SET:-0}" = 1 ] || deadline=$((start + max_s + 30))
   264	  prev=$(date +%s); dl0=$deadline
   265	  retried=0
   266	  while :; do
   267	    if hl_done "$role" "$id"; then
   268	      if [ "$retried" = 0 ] && hl_resume_missing "$role"; then
   269	        # the session is gone: one fresh run in the same ask; the dead sid must not stay the resume target
   270	        retried=1
   271	        echo "harness: resume of ${resume:0:8} failed, running fresh" >&2
   272	        resume=""; ctxb=""

   274	        continue
   275	      fi
   276	      hl_collect "$role"
   277	    fi
   278	    if ! hl_alive "$role"; then
   279	      # the runner may still be writing exit.json (jq, mv) as its pid disappears: give it ~3 s
   280	      g=0; while [ "$g" -lt 30 ] && ! hl_done "$role" "$id"; do sleep 0.1; g=$((g + 1)); done

   282	      sid=$(sed -n 1p "$a.session" 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-8)

   284	        echo "harness: $role's run is gone without a result (killed?); --keep resumes session $sid"
   285	      else
   286	        echo "harness: $role's run is gone without a result (killed?); it recorded no session (--keep resumes the last successful one, if any)"
   287	      fi
   288	      exit 3
   289	    fi
   290	    now=$(date +%s)
   291	    deadline=$(hl_deadline_bump "$prev" "$now" "$poll" "$deadline" "$max_s" "$dl0"); prev=$now

   294	        # the Stop hook has hidden the report while it verifies; the run is never killed at the deadline
   295	        echo "harness: $role is still verifying (Stop hook running, $(cat .harness/verify/implementer.attempts 2>/dev/null || echo 0) failed attempt(s) so far, $((now - start))s); collect: harness report $role; stop: harness close $role --force" >&2
   296	        exit 4
   297	      fi
   298	      echo "harness: $role is still running (pid $(hl_pid "$role"), $((now - start))s); collect: harness report $role; stop: harness close $role --force" >&2
   299	      exit 4
   300	    fi
   301	    sleep "$poll"
   302	  done
   303	}
   304	
   305	# report_headless <role> — `harness report` for a headless role; always exits
   306	report_headless() {
   307	  local role=$1 report="$REPORT_DIR/$1.md"
   308	  if hl_alive "$role"; then
   309	    echo "harness: still running ($(( $(date +%s) - $(awk 'NR == 1 { print $2 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) ))s); harness wait $role blocks until done" >&2
   310	    exit 4
   311	  fi
   312	  if [ ! -f "$ASK_DIR/$role.exit.json" ]; then
   313	    echo "harness: no finished run for $role" >&2
   314	    exit 3
   315	  fi
   316	  hl_collect "$role"
   317	}
   318	
   319	# hl_kill <role> — stop the role's run: TERM the runner (it kills its tree and writes
   320	# exit.json killed:signal), wait up to 5 s, then kill the tree
   321	hl_kill() {
   322	  local role=$1 pid i=0 id
   323	  pid=$(hl_pid "$role"); id=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.pid" 2>/dev/null)
   324	  digits_only "$pid" || return 0
   325	  kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null
   326	  while [ "$i" -lt 50 ]; do
   327	    hl_alive "$role" || return 0
   328	    sleep 0.1; i=$((i + 1))
   329	  done
   330	  kill_tree "$pid"; kill -KILL "$pid" 2>/dev/null
   331	  return 0
   332	}
   333	
   334	# hl_finish_close <role> <reason> — drop the conversation (--keep must not resume a session across
   335	# a close), log
   336	hl_finish_close() {
   337	  local a="$ASK_DIR/$1"
   338	  # .current ends the run slot: status shows "-" again (exit.json stays for the post-mortem)
   339	  rm -f "$a.session" "$a.current"
   340	  log_close "$1" "$2" headless
   341	  echo "closed $1"
   342	}
   343	
   344	# close_headless <role> <force> — close the role's run slot: kill a live run (--force)
   345	close_headless() {
   346	  local role=$1 force=$2 reason=manual
   347	  if ! hl_alive "$role" && [ ! -f "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" ]; then
   348	    die "$role is not running"
   349	  fi
   350	  if hl_alive "$role"; then
   351	    if [ "$force" != 1 ]; then
   352	      echo "harness: $role has a run in progress (pid $(hl_pid "$role")); not closing (use --force to kill it)" >&2
   353	      return 4
   354	    fi
   355	    hl_kill "$role"
   356	    reason=force_kill
   357	  fi
   358	  hl_finish_close "$role" "$reason"
   359	}
   360	
   361	# hl_target <cmd> <target> — validate the role for wait/watch: sets ASK_AGENT; dies for an unknown one
   362	hl_target() {
   363	  case " $AGENTS " in
   364	    *" $2 "*) ASK_AGENT=$2 ;;
   365	    *) die "$1: unknown agent '$2' (expected one of: $AGENTS)" ;;
   366	  esac
   367	}
   368	# hl_starting <role> <id> — the run was just launched and has not written its pid file yet
   369	hl_starting() {
   370	  local a="$ASK_DIR/$1" st
   371	  grep -q "^$2 " "$a.pid" 2>/dev/null && return 1
   372	  st=$(awk -v i="$2" 'NR == 1 && $1 == i { print $2 }' "$a.current" 2>/dev/null)
   373	  digits_only "${st:-}" && [ $(( $(date +%s) - st )) -lt "${HARNESS_HL_START_S:-15}" ]
   374	}
   375	
   376	# cmd_wait <role> [--timeout ms] — block until the target's run ends; never collects.
   377	# 0 done (exit.json carries the ask), 3 no ask / run gone without a result, 4 timeout.
   378	cmd_wait() {
   379	  local t=${1:-} timeout="" role id a start deadline dl0 max_s prev now g poll=${HARNESS_POLL_SEC:-2}
   380	  [ -n "$t" ] || usage
   381	  shift
   382	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
   383	    case "$1" in
   384	      --timeout) case "${2:-}" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) die "--timeout needs a number of milliseconds" ;; esac; timeout=$2; shift 2 ;;
   385	      *) usage ;;
   386	    esac
   387	  done
   388	  hl_target wait "$t"
   389	  role=$ASK_AGENT; a="$ASK_DIR/$role"
   390	  id=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$a.current" 2>/dev/null)
   391	  [ -n "$id" ] || { echo "harness: no ask for $role" >&2; exit 3; }
   392	  [ -n "$timeout" ] || timeout=$(( $(hl_max_s "$role") * 1000 ))
   393	  start=$(date +%s); deadline=$((start + (timeout + 999) / 1000)); prev=$start; dl0=$deadline; max_s=$(hl_max_s "$role")
   394	  while :; do
   395	    if hl_done "$role" "$id"; then echo "done; collect: harness report $role"; exit 0; fi
   396	    if ! hl_alive "$role" && ! hl_starting "$role" "$id"; then
   397	      # the runner may still be writing exit.json as its pid disappears: the same ~3 s grace as ask
   398	      g=0; while [ "$g" -lt 30 ] && ! hl_done "$role" "$id"; do sleep 0.1; g=$((g + 1)); done
   399	      if hl_done "$role" "$id"; then continue; fi
   400	      echo "harness: $role's run is gone without a result (killed?); harness report $role explains" >&2
   401	      exit 3
   402	    fi
   403	    now=$(date +%s)
   404	    deadline=$(hl_deadline_bump "$prev" "$now" "$poll" "$deadline" "$max_s" "$dl0"); prev=$now
   405	    if [ "$now" -ge "$deadline" ]; then
   406	      echo "harness: $role is still running ($((now - start))s waited); harness wait $role again, or harness close $role --force" >&2
   407	      exit 4
   408	    fi
   409	    sleep "$poll"
   410	  done
   411	}
   412	
   413	# hl_stream_of <role> — the raw stream of the role's current/last run (empty when unknown): .stream when its
   414	# id is the current ask, else exit.json's stream_log; a rotated stream is <raw>.gz
   415	hl_stream_of() {
   416	  local a="$ASK_DIR/$1" raw cur
   417	  cur=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$a.current" 2>/dev/null)
   418	  raw=$(awk -v i="$cur" 'NR == 1 && $1 == i { print $2 }' "$a.stream" 2>/dev/null)
   419	  [ -n "$raw" ] || raw=$(jq -r '.stream_log // empty' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
   420	  [ -n "$raw" ] || raw=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $2 }' "$a.stream" 2>/dev/null)
   421	  printf '%s' "$raw"
   422	}
   423	
   424	hl_stream_id() { awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$1.stream" 2>/dev/null; }
   425	
   426	# cmd_watch <role> [-n N] — human only: a live run as a redrawn dashboard (lib/harness-dash.sh), or print the last N
   427	# (default 40) rendered lines of a finished one. 0 ok, 1 refused (not a tty), 3 no stream known.
   428	cmd_watch() {
   429	  local t=${1:-} n=40 nset="" role raw i id
   430	  [ -n "$t" ] || usage
   431	  shift
   432	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
   433	    case "$1" in
   434	      -n) case "${2:-}" in ''|*[!0-9]*) die "-n needs a number of lines" ;; esac; n=$2; nset=1; shift 2 ;;
   435	      *) usage ;;
   436	    esac
   437	  done
   438	  [ -t 1 ] || die "watch is for a human terminal; the conductor reads the report"
   439	  hl_target watch "$t"
   440	  role=$ASK_AGENT
   441	  id=$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" 2>/dev/null)
   442	  raw=$(hl_stream_of "$role"); i=0
   443	  # a run that is still starting has not announced its stream yet: give it a few seconds
   444	  while [ "$(hl_stream_id "$role")" != "$id" ] && [ "$i" -lt 100 ] && { hl_alive "$role" || hl_starting "$role" "$id"; }; do
   445	    sleep 0.2; i=$((i + 1)); raw=$(hl_stream_of "$role")
   446	  done
   447	  if [ -z "$raw" ]; then echo "harness: no stream known for $t" >&2; exit 3; fi
   448	  # -n N (or a rotated .gz stream): one-shot plain tail of a finished run (scrollback text; reflows by itself)
   449	  if { [ -n "$nset" ] || [ ! -f "$raw" ]; } && ! hl_alive "$role"; then
   450	    if [ -f "$raw" ]; then harness-view < "$raw" | tail -n "$n"
   451	    elif [ -f "$raw.gz" ]; then gzip -dc "$raw.gz" | harness-view | tail -n "$n"
   452	    else echo "harness: stream $raw is gone" >&2; exit 3; fi
   453	    exit 0
   454	  fi
   455	  dash_watch "$role" "$raw" "$id"
   456	  exit 0
   457	}

   234	      [ -z "$l" ] || out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Recent ──"$'\n'"$l"
   235	    fi
   236	  fi
   237	  # cut by display width (East-Asian Wide/Fullwidth incl. emoji = 2 columns; jq works in code points, bash 3.2
   238	  # ${v:0:n} in bytes) so no line wraps; a line is clipped, never wrapped. Tabs become 2 spaces first.
   239	  # Cut at W-1 columns: the trailing \033[K (dash_paint) must never erase the last glyph with autowrap off.
   240	  printf '%s\n' "$out" | jq -R -r --argjson w "$((W > 1 ? W - 1 : 1))" "$DASH_JQ_CW"'
   241	    gsub("\t"; "  ") | ctl | explode | reduce .[] as $c ({w: 0, o: [], f: false};
   242	      if .f then . else ($c | cw) as $k | if .w + $k > $w then .f = true else .w += $k | .o += [$c] end end)
   243	    | .o | implode'

   246	# dash_begin / dash_end — hide the cursor and turn terminal autowrap off while the loop draws, so a width
   247	# miscount can only cut a line short, never wrap or scroll; dash_end restores both and ends the line
   248	# dash_end is idempotent (traps + normal exit may both call it): only the first call after dash_begin prints
   249	DASH_ON=0
   250	dash_begin() { DASH_ON=1; printf '\033[?25l\033[?7l'; }
   251	dash_end() { [ "$DASH_ON" = 1 ] || return 0; DASH_ON=0; printf '\033[?7h\033[?25h\n'; }
   252	
   253	# dash_paint <frame> — redraw in place (no full clear, so no flicker): home, each line cleared to its
   254	# end, then everything below the frame cleared
   255	dash_paint() {
   256	  printf '\033[H'
   257	  # no newline after the last line: a frame of exactly H lines would scroll the pane by one every tick
   258	  printf '%s\n' "$1" | awk 'BEGIN { e = sprintf("%c", 27) } { if (NR > 1) printf "\n"; printf "%s%s[K", $0, e }'
   259	  printf '\033[J'
   260	}
   261	
   262	# dash_watch <role> <raw> <id> — the viewer loop: live frames every HARNESS_DASH_SEC and on SIGWINCH, then the final
   263	# frame, kept alive and re-rendered on a size change (polled every HARNESS_DASH_IDLE_SEC too) until HUP/INT/TERM/QUIT
   264	# or the ask is removed or replaced. dash_end runs on every exit path.
   265	dash_watch() {
   266	  local role=$1 raw=$2 id=$3
   267	  trap 'dash_end; exit 130' INT TERM
   268	  trap 'dash_end; exit 129' HUP
   269	  trap 'dash_end; exit 131' QUIT
   270	  trap dash_end EXIT
   271	  trap 'DASH_WINCH=1' WINCH
   272	  dash_begin
   273	  if hl_alive "$role"; then
   274	    while hl_alive "$role" && ! hl_done "$role" "$id"; do
   275	      DASH_WINCH=0
   276	      dash_paint "$(hl_dash_frame "$role" "$raw")"
   277	      [ "$DASH_WINCH" = 1 ] || dash_nap "${HARNESS_DASH_SEC:-2}"
   278	    done
   279	    sleep 1   # let the runner write exit.json
   280	  fi
   281	  local sz="" now
   282	  while :; do
   283	    DASH_WINCH=0; now=$(dash_size)
   284	    if [ "$now" != "$sz" ]; then
   285	      sz=$now
   286	      dash_paint "$(HARNESS_DASH_FINAL=1 hl_dash_frame "$role" "$raw")"
   287	    fi
   288	    # the ask was removed or replaced: nothing left to show
   289	    [ "$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" 2>/dev/null)" = "$id" ] || break
   290	    [ "$DASH_WINCH" = 1 ] || dash_nap "${HARNESS_DASH_IDLE_SEC:-1}"
   291	  done
   292	  dash_end
   293	}

    55	# enter_root [dir] — cd to the harness root of dir (hook stdin cwd, else the process cwd)

   122	# changed_files [BASE] -> files (relative to the cwd) changed since BASE (default:
   123	# the baseline, else HEAD) plus untracked ones, one per line
   124	changed_files() {
   125	  local base=${1:-} f

   136	# change_class -> docs-only|wiki|code: what the ask changed since its baseline.
   137	# Paths = committed since the baseline HEAD + staged + unstaged (git diff BASE,
   138	# deletions included) + untracked. Source committed in an EARLIER ask is not
   139	# "since baseline" (the baseline is per ask), so it never counts. Every path under
   140	# docs/ or .harness/ -> docs-only (wiki when any is under docs/wiki/); anything else
   141	# (AGENTS.md, README.md and agents/*.md included: tests read them) -> code.
   142	# docs/ and .harness/ are ROOT's (the cwd's): paths are listed from the git toplevel
   143	# with rename detection off (a move into docs/ lists the source path too), and any
   144	# path outside ROOT counts as code.
   145	change_class() {
   146	  local base f top rel wiki=0 any=0
   147	  base=$(sed -n 1p "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" 2>/dev/null)
   148	  [ -n "$base" ] || { echo code; return; }
   149	  git rev-parse --verify -q "$base^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo code; return; }

   151	  top=$(cd "$top" && pwd -P)

   153	  rel=$(git rev-parse --show-prefix 2>/dev/null)

   155	    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
   156	    any=1

   158	      "$rel"docs/wiki/*) wiki=1 ;;
   159	      "$rel"docs/*|"$rel".harness/*) ;;

   161	    esac
   162	  done <<EOF_PATHS
   163	$({ git -c core.quotepath=off diff --no-renames --name-only "$base" 2>/dev/null
   164	    git -c core.quotepath=off -C "$top" ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null; } | sort -u)
   165	EOF_PATHS
   166	  [ "$any" = 1 ] || { echo code; return; }
   167	  if [ "$wiki" = 1 ]; then echo wiki; else echo docs-only; fi
   168	}

   170	# harness_bin -> path of the sibling `harness` (symlink-resolved), else PATH
   171	harness_bin() {

   182	quote_files() {

   198	    esac
   199	  done

   201	}
   202	
   203	# --- running steps -------------------------------------------------------------
   204	
   205	# run_step STEP FILES — STEP is lint|test, FILES newline-separated. Sets
   206	# STEP_OUT, RAN. Returns the command's status; 0 when the step is absent or has
   207	# {files} but no (matching) files exist.
   208	run_step() {
   209	  local cmd q rc
   210	  STEP_OUT=""
   211	  cmd=$(resolve_step "$1")

   213	  case "$cmd" in

411	   117	    {format: ($f | nz), lint: ($l | nz), test: ($t | nz), app: $a, maxAttempts: $m}'
412	   118	}
413	   119	
414	   120	# --- files ---------------------------------------------------------------------
415	   121	
416	   122	# changed_files [BASE] -> files (relative to the cwd) changed since BASE (default:
417	   123	# the baseline, else HEAD) plus untracked ones, one per line
418	   124	changed_files() {
419	   125	  local base=${1:-} f
420	   126	  [ "$IS_GIT" = 1 ] || return 0
421	   127	  [ -n "$base" ] || base=$(sed -n 1p "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" 2>/dev/null)
422	   128	  [ -n "$base" ] || base=HEAD
423	   129	  { git -c core.quotepath=off diff --relative --name-only "$base" -- . ':(exclude).harness' 2>/dev/null
424	   130	    git -c core.quotepath=off ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- . ':(exclude).harness' 2>/dev/null
425	   131	  } | sort -u | while IFS= read -r f; do
426	   132	    [ -f "$f" ] && printf '%s\n' "$f"
427	   133	  done
428	   134	}
429	   135	
430	   136	# change_class -> docs-only|wiki|code: what the ask changed since its baseline.
431	   137	# Paths = committed since the baseline HEAD + staged + unstaged (git diff BASE,
432	   138	# deletions included) + untracked. Source committed in an EARLIER ask is not
433	   139	# "since baseline" (the baseline is per ask), so it never counts. Every path under
434	   140	# docs/ or .harness/ -> docs-only (wiki when any is under docs/wiki/); anything else
435	   141	# (AGENTS.md, README.md and agents/*.md included: tests read them) -> code.
436	   142	# docs/ and .harness/ are ROOT's (the cwd's): paths are listed from the git toplevel
437	   143	# with rename detection off (a move into docs/ lists the source path too), and any
438	   144	# path outside ROOT counts as code.
439	   145	change_class() {
440	   146	  local base f top rel wiki=0 any=0
441	   147	  base=$(sed -n 1p "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" 2>/dev/null)
442	   148	  [ -n "$base" ] || { echo code; return; }
443	   149	  git rev-parse --verify -q "$base^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo code; return; }
444	   150	  top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { echo code; return; }
445	   151	  top=$(cd "$top" && pwd -P)
446	   152	  # prefix of ROOT (the cwd) inside the toplevel: "" at the top, "pkg/" in a subdir
447	   153	  rel=$(git rev-parse --show-prefix 2>/dev/null)
448	   154	  while IFS= read -r f; do
449	   155	    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
450	   156	    any=1
451	   157	    case "$f" in
452	   158	      "$rel"docs/wiki/*) wiki=1 ;;
453	   159	      "$rel"docs/*|"$rel".harness/*) ;;
454	   160	      *) echo code; return ;;
455	   161	    esac
456	   162	  done <<EOF_PATHS
457	   163	$({ git -c core.quotepath=off diff --no-renames --name-only "$base" 2>/dev/null
458	   164	    git -c core.quotepath=off -C "$top" ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null; } | sort -u)
459	   165	EOF_PATHS
460	   166	  [ "$any" = 1 ] || { echo code; return; }
461	   167	  if [ "$wiki" = 1 ]; then echo wiki; else echo docs-only; fi
462	   168	}
463	   169	
464	   170	# harness_bin -> path of the sibling `harness` (symlink-resolved), else PATH
465	   171	harness_bin() {
466	   172	  local s=${BASH_SOURCE[0]} d
467	   173	  while [ -h "$s" ]; do
468	   174	    d=$(cd "$(dirname "$s")" && pwd); s=$(readlink "$s")
469	   175	    case "$s" in /*) ;; *) s="$d/$s" ;; esac
470	   176	  done
471	   177	  d=$(cd "$(dirname "$s")" && pwd)
472	   178	  if [ -x "$d/harness" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$d/harness"; else command -v harness; fi
473	   179	}
474	   180	
475	   181	# quote_files -> stdin lines to one shell-quoted, space-separated string
476	   182	quote_files() {
477	   183	  local f out=""
478	   184	  while IFS= read -r f; do
479	   185	    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
480	   186	    out="$out $(printf '%q' "$f")"
481	   187	  done
482	   188	  printf '%s' "${out# }"
483	   189	}
484	   190	
485	   191	# expand_files CMD QUOTED -> CMD with every {files} replaced
486	   192	expand_files() {
487	   193	  local c=$1 q=$2 tok='{files}' out=""
488	   194	  while :; do
489	   195	    case "$c" in
490	   196	      *"$tok"*) out="$out${c%%"$tok"*}$q"; c=${c#*"$tok"} ;;
491	   197	      *) break ;;
492	   198	    esac
493	   199	  done
494	   200	  printf '%s' "$out$c"
495	   201	}
496	   202	
497	   203	# --- running steps -------------------------------------------------------------
498	   204	
499	   205	# run_step STEP FILES — STEP is lint|test, FILES newline-separated. Sets
500	   206	# STEP_OUT, RAN. Returns the command's status; 0 when the step is absent or has
501	   207	# {files} but no (matching) files exist.
502	   208	run_step() {
503	   209	  local cmd q rc
504	   210	  STEP_OUT=""
505	   211	  cmd=$(resolve_step "$1")
506	   212	  [ -n "$cmd" ] || return 0
507	   213	  case "$cmd" in
508	   214	    *'{files}'*)
509	   215	      q=$(printf '%s\n' "${2:-}" | quote_files)
510	   216	      [ -n "$q" ] || return 0
511	   217	      cmd=$(expand_files "$cmd" "$q") ;;
512	   218	  esac
513	   219	  RAN=1
514	   220	  STEP_OUT=$(/bin/bash -c "$cmd" </dev/null 2>&1)
515	   221	  rc=$?
516	   222	  return $rc
517	   223	}
518	   224	
519	   225	tail40() { printf '%s\n' "$1" | tail -n 40; }
520	   226	
521	   227	cmd_run() {
522	   228	  local what=${1:-all} files="" rc=0 ran_any=0 baseref=main mb="" explicit=0
523	   229	  case "$what" in lint|test|all) shift ;; --*) what=all ;; *) warn "usage: harness-verify run [lint|test|all] [--base REF]"; exit 1 ;; esac
524	   230	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
525	   231	    case "$1" in
526	   232	      --base) [ $# -ge 2 ] || { warn "--base needs a ref"; exit 1; }; baseref=$2; explicit=1; shift 2 ;;
527	   233	      *) warn "usage: harness-verify run [lint|test|all] [--base REF]"; exit 1 ;;
528	   234	    esac
529	   235	  done
530	   236	  enter_root
531	   237	  if [ "$IS_GIT" = 1 ]; then
532	   238	    if [ "$explicit" = 0 ] && ! git rev-parse --verify -q "$baseref^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
533	   239	      baseref=master
534	   240	    fi
535	   241	    mb=$(git merge-base "$baseref" HEAD 2>/dev/null) || mb=""
536	   242	    if [ -z "$mb" ]; then
537	   243	      warn "base ref '$baseref' does not resolve (use --base <ref>)"
538	   244	      exit 2
539	   245	    fi
540	   246	  fi
541	   247	  files=$(changed_files "$mb")
542	   248	  [ -n "$files" ] || warn "no changed files versus $baseref"
543	   249	  if [ "$what" = lint ] || [ "$what" = all ]; then
544	   250	    RAN=0
545	   251	    run_step lint "$files" || rc=1
546	   252	    [ "$RAN" -eq 0 ] || { ran_any=1; printf '== lint ==\n%s\n' "$STEP_OUT"; }
547	   253	    [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit 1
548	   254	  fi
549	   255	  if [ "$what" = test ] || [ "$what" = all ]; then
550	   256	    RAN=0
551	   257	    run_step test "$files" || rc=1
552	   258	    [ "$RAN" -eq 0 ] || { ran_any=1; printf '== test ==\n%s\n' "$STEP_OUT"; }
553	   259	    [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit 1
554	   260	  fi
555	   261	  [ "$ran_any" -eq 1 ] || echo "harness-verify: nothing to run"
556	   262	  exit 0
557	   263	}
558	   264	
559	   265	# --- state ---------------------------------------------------------------------
560	   266	
561	   267	# state_id -> HEAD sha and a hash of the working tree changes (outside .harness/)
562	   268	state_id() {
563	   269	  local head h
564	   270	  head=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)
565	   271	  h=$({ git status --porcelain -- . ':(exclude).harness'
566	   272	        git diff HEAD -- . ':(exclude).harness'
567	   273	        git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- . ':(exclude).harness' | while IFS= read -r f; do
568	   274	          printf '%s\n' "$f"; cat "$f" 2>/dev/null
569	   275	        done; } 2>/dev/null | cksum)
570	   276	  printf '%s\n%s\n' "$head" "$h"
571	   277	}
572	   278	
573	   279	write_result() { # status step tail attempts
574	   280	  mkdir -p "$STATE_REL"
575	   281	  jq -n -c --arg s "$1" --arg st "$2" --arg t "$3" --argjson a "${4:-0}" \
576	   282	    '{status: $s, attempts: $a, step: $st, tail: $t}' > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.json"
577	   283	}
578	   284	
579	   285	cmd_baseline() {
580	   286	  set_agent "${1:-}"
581	   287	  enter_root
582	   288	  # after a verify FAIL keep the original .base: the next ask must still compare
583	   289	  # against the tree the failing work started from
584	   290	  local prev=""
585	   291	  prev=$(jq -r '.status // empty' "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.json" 2>/dev/null)
586	   292	  rm -f "${STATE_REL:?}/${AGENT:?}.json" ".harness/reports/${AGENT:?}.md.pending"
587	   293	  if [ "$IS_GIT" != 1 ]; then
588	   294	    warn "not a git repo, no baseline"
589	   295	    exit 0
590	   296	  fi
591	   297	  mkdir -p "$STATE_REL"
592	   298	  if [ "$prev" != fail ] || [ ! -s "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" ]; then
593	   299	    state_id > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base"
594	   300	  fi
595	   301	  echo 0 > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.attempts"
596	   302	  exit 0
597	   303	}
598	   304	
599	   305	# --- hooks ---------------------------------------------------------------------
600	   306	
601	   307	# cmd_done ROLE — Stop hook for workers without verification (analyst, reviewer): the report gate only
602	   308	cmd_done() {
603	   309	  local input
604	   310	  input=$(cat)
605	   311	  enter_root "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
606	   312	  set_agent "${1:-}"
607	   313	  report_gate
608	   314	  exit 0
609	   315	}
610	   316	
611	   317	# cmd_stop — verification Stop hook: runs the checks and prints their block decision, if any.
612	   318	cmd_stop() {
613	   319	  local input out
614	   320	  input=$(cat)
615	   321	  # the verification runs in a subshell (it exits through many paths)
616	   322	  out=$(STOP_INPUT=$input stop_body)
617	   323	  [ -z "$out" ] || printf '%s\n' "$out"
618	   324	  exit 0
619	   325	}
620	   326	
621	   327	# report_gate — a harness ask must end with a fresh report: block the stop (at most twice per ask)
622	   328	# so the worker writes it instead of the ask exiting 3. `[no-report]` opts out, as a marker only: at the
623	   329	# start of the instruction, or on a line of its own in the brief the instruction points at.
624	   330	report_gate() {
625	   331	  local a=.harness/asks/$AGENT id n brief rep=.harness/reports/$AGENT.md
626	   332	  case "$AGENT" in analyst|implementer|reviewer) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
627	   333	  [ -f "$a.current" ] || return 0
628	   334	  case "$(head -n 1 "$a.prompt" 2>/dev/null)" in '[no-report]'*) return 0 ;; esac
629	   335	  # an instruction that only says "Read .harness/<brief>.md and do it": the opt-out may sit in the brief
630	   336	  brief=$(sed -n 's/.*Read \(\.harness\/[^ ]*\.md\).*/\1/p' "$a.prompt" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
631	   337	  case "$brief" in ''|*..*) ;; *) grep -qx '[[:space:]]*\[no-report\][[:space:]]*' "$brief" 2>/dev/null && return 0 ;; esac
632	   338	  [ -f "$rep" ] && [ ! "$rep" -ot "$a.current" ] && return 0
633	   339	  [ -f "$rep.pending" ] && [ ! "$rep.pending" -ot "$a.current" ] && return 0
634	   340	  id=$(awk 'NR==1 { print $1 }' "$a.current")
635	   341	  n=$(awk -v i="$id" '$1==i { print $2 }' "$a.reportblocks" 2>/dev/null)
636	   342	  case "$n" in ''|*[!0-9]*) n=0 ;; esac
637	   343	  [ "$n" -lt 2 ] || return 0
638	   344	  printf '%s %s\n' "$id" $((n + 1)) > "$a.reportblocks"
639	   345	  jq -n -c --arg r "write .harness/reports/$AGENT.md for this ask (the report contract in your prompt), then stop" '{decision: "block", reason: $r}'
640	   346	  exit 0
641	   347	}
642	   348	
643	   349	stop_body() {
644	   350	  local input=$STOP_INPUT attempts max files step="" out reason rep pend cls hb
645	   351	  set_agent "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.agent_type // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
646	   352	  enter_root "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
647	   353	  report_gate
648	   354	  if [ "$IS_GIT" != 1 ]; then
649	   355	    exit 0
650	   356	  fi
651	   357	  if [ -f "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" ] && [ "$(state_id)" = "$(cat "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base")" ]; then
652	   358	    write_result skipped "" "" 0
653	   359	    exit 0
654	   360	  fi
655	   361	  # hide the report while verifying so `harness ask/report` never sees an unverified one
656	   362	  rep=".harness/reports/${AGENT:?}.md"; pend="$rep.pending"
657	   363	  [ ! -f "$rep" ] || mv -f "$rep" "$pend"
658	   364	  attempts=$(cat "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.attempts" 2>/dev/null)
659	   365	  case "$attempts" in ''|*[!0-9]*) attempts=0 ;; esac
660	   366	  max=$(max_attempts)
661	   367	  files=$(changed_files)
662	   368	
663	   369	  RAN=0
664	   370	  cls=$(change_class)
665	   371	  if [ "$cls" = wiki ]; then
666	   372	    # docs/wiki changed: only the wiki checks run, no lint / test suite
667	   373	    hb=$(harness_bin)
668	   374	    if [ -n "$hb" ] && ! out=$("$hb" wiki-lint 2>&1); then step=wiki-lint; fi
669	   375	    if [ -z "$step" ]; then
670	   376	      [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
671	   377	      write_result skipped "skipped (docs-only)" "" "$attempts"
672	   378	      exit 0
673	   379	    fi
674	   380	  elif [ "$cls" = docs-only ]; then
675	   381	    [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
676	   382	    write_result skipped "skipped (docs-only)" "" "$attempts"
677	   383	    exit 0
678	   384	  elif ! run_step lint "$files"; then
679	   385	    step=lint; out=$STEP_OUT
680	   386	  elif ! run_step test "$files"; then
681	   387	    step=test; out=$STEP_OUT
682	   388	  fi
683	   389	  if [ -z "$step" ]; then
684	   390	    [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
685	   391	    if [ "$RAN" -eq 1 ]; then write_result pass "" "" "$attempts"; else write_result skipped "" "" "$attempts"; fi
686	   392	    exit 0
687	   393	  fi
688	   394	  out=$(tail40 "$out")
689	   395	  if [ "$attempts" -lt "$max" ]; then
690	   396	    attempts=$((attempts + 1))
691	   397	    echo "$attempts" > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.attempts"
692	   398	    rm -f "$pend"
693	   399	    write_result fail "$step" "$out" "$attempts"
694	   400	    reason=$(printf 'Verification failed at step %s (attempt %s of %s). Last output:\n%s\n\nFix the cause and finish again; then rewrite the report.' "$step" "$attempts" "$max" "$out")
695	   401	    jq -n -c --arg r "$reason" '{decision: "block", reason: $r}'
696	   402	    exit 0
697	   403	  fi
698	   404	  # cap reached: keep the worker's final report so `harness ask` exits 5 with it
699	   405	  [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
700	   406	  write_result fail "$step" "$out" "$attempts"
701	   407	  exit 0
702	   408	}
703	   409	
704	   410	cmd_format() {
705	   411	  local input="" file="${1:-}" tool cwd q out fcmd lcmd d
706	   412	  if [ -z "$file" ]; then
707	   413	    input=$(cat)
708	   414	    tool=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty' 2>/dev/null)
709	   415	    case "$tool" in
710	   416	      Edit|Write|MultiEdit) ;;
711	   417	      *) exit 0 ;;
712	   418	    esac
713	   419	    file=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null)
714	   420	    cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)
715	   421	    set_agent "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.agent_type // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
716	   422	  else
717	   423	    cwd=""
718	   424	  fi
719	   425	  enter_root "$cwd"
720	   426	  [ -n "$file" ] || exit 0
721	   427	  case "$file" in
722	   428	    /*)
723	   429	      # compare physical paths (macOS /var -> /private/var)
724	   430	      d=$(CDPATH= cd -P "${file%/*}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || exit 0
725	   431	      file="$d/${file##*/}"
726	   432	      case "$file" in
727	   433	        "$ROOT"/*) file=${file#"$ROOT"/} ;;
728	   434	        *) exit 0 ;;
729	   435	      esac ;;
730	   436	  esac
731	   437	  case "$file" in .harness/*|.git/*|*/../*|../*) exit 0 ;; esac
732	   438	  [ -f "$file" ] || exit 0
733	   439	  fcmd=$(resolve_step format)
734	   440	  if [ -n "$fcmd" ]; then
735	   441	    case "$fcmd" in
736	   442	      *'{files}'*)
737	   443	        q=$(printf '%s\n' "$file" | quote_files)
738	   444	        fcmd=$(expand_files "$fcmd" "$q") ;;
739	   445	    esac
740	   446	    [ -z "$fcmd" ] || /bin/bash -c "$fcmd" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
741	   447	  fi
742	   448	  lcmd=$(resolve_step lint)
743	   449	  case "$lcmd" in
744	   450	    *'{files}'*)
745	   451	      q=$(printf '%s\n' "$file" | quote_files)
746	   452	      lcmd=$(expand_files "$lcmd" "$q")
747	   453	      if ! out=$(/bin/bash -c "$lcmd" </dev/null 2>&1); then
748	   454	        out=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | head -n 40)
749	   455	        jq -n -c --arg r "$(printf 'Lint failed for %s:\n%s' "$file" "$out")" '{decision: "block", reason: $r}'
750	   456	      fi ;;
751	   457	  esac
752	   458	  exit 0
753	   459	}
754	   460	
755	   461	case "${1:-}" in
756	   462	  detect)   enter_root; cmd_detect ;;
757	   463	  format)   shift; cmd_format "$@" ;;
758	   464	  stop)     cmd_stop ;;
759	   465	  done)     shift; cmd_done "$@" ;;
760	   466	  run)      shift; cmd_run "$@" ;;
761	   467	  baseline) shift; cmd_baseline "$@" ;;
762	   468	  *)
763	   469	    echo "usage: harness-verify detect | format [file] | stop | done ROLE | run [lint|test|all] | baseline [agent]" >&2
764	   470	    exit 1 ;;
765	   471	esac
766	   472	exit $?
767	   473	}

1	# harness-dash.sh — the viewer dashboard frame for `harness watch <role>` (a live run).
     2	# Sourced eagerly by bin/harness: definitions only, no side effects. hl_dash_frame is a pure
     3	# render (inputs: .harness/asks/<role>.*, the stream, verify/<role>.*) -> text on stdout; the
     4	# redraw loop lives in cmd_watch. bash 3.2 + jq; Recent reuses harness-view (PATH).
     5	
     6	# dash_fmt_dur <seconds> — 45s | 12m04s | 1h02m
     7	dash_fmt_dur() {
     8	  local s=${1:-0}
     9	  case "$s" in ''|*[!0-9]*) s=0 ;; esac
    10	  if [ "$s" -ge 3600 ]; then printf '%dh%02dm' $((s / 3600)) $((s % 3600 / 60))
    11	  elif [ "$s" -ge 60 ]; then printf '%dm%02ds' $((s / 60)) $((s % 60))
    12	  else printf '%ds' "$s"; fi
    13	}
    14	
    15	# dash_min A B
    16	dash_min() { if [ "$1" -lt "$2" ]; then echo "$1"; else echo "$2"; fi; }
    17	
    18	# dash_brief <role> — title line, then "S<TAB>step" / "H<TAB>heading" lines. The brief is the task
    19	# file only when the ask's prompt names it; otherwise the prompt text itself (first line, no steps).
    20	dash_brief() {
    21	  local role=$1 p="$ASK_DIR/$1.prompt" f=".harness/task-$1.md"
    22	  if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qF "$f" "$p" 2>/dev/null; then
    23	    awk '
    24	      BEGIN { t = ""; sec = 0 }
    25	      /^# / && t == "" { t = substr($0, 3); next }
    26	      /^## / { h[++nh] = substr($0, 4); sec = ($0 ~ /^## Steps[ \t]*$/); next }
    27	      sec && /^[0-9]+[.)] / { s = $0; sub(/^[0-9]+[.)] +/, "", s); st[++ns] = ++k ". " s }
    28	      END {
    29	        print (t == "" ? "(untitled brief)" : t)
    30	        if (ns > 0) { for (i = 1; i <= ns; i++) print "S\t" st[i] }
    31	        else { for (i = 1; i <= nh; i++) print "H\t" h[i] }
    32	      }' "$f"
    33	  else
    34	    awk 'NR == 1 { print; exit }' "$p" 2>/dev/null
    35	  fi
    36	}
    37	
    38	# dash_facts <raw> — one JSON object of what the stream says (model, turns, ctx, now, verify)
    39	dash_facts() {
    40	  local raw=$1
    41	  { if [ -f "$raw" ]; then cat "$raw"; elif [ -f "$raw.gz" ]; then gzip -dc "$raw.gz"; fi; } 2>/dev/null | jq -R -n -c '
    42	    def first_line: tostring | split("\n")[0];
    43	    [inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")] as $e
    44	    | ([$e[] | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "init")] | first) as $i
    45	    | [$e[] | select(.type == "assistant")] as $a
    46	    | ([$a[] | .message.usage?] | map(select(. != null)) | last) as $u

   246	# dash_begin / dash_end — hide the cursor and turn terminal autowrap off while the loop draws, so a width
   247	# miscount can only cut a line short, never wrap or scroll; dash_end restores both and ends the line
   248	# dash_end is idempotent (traps + normal exit may both call it): only the first call after dash_begin prints

   251	dash_end() { [ "$DASH_ON" = 1 ] || return 0; DASH_ON=0; printf '\033[?7h\033[?25h\n'; }

   253	# dash_paint <frame> — redraw in place (no full clear, so no flicker): home, each line cleared to its
   254	# end, then everything below the frame cleared
   255	dash_paint() {
   256	  printf '\033[H'
   257	  # no newline after the last line: a frame of exactly H lines would scroll the pane by one every tick
   258	  printf '%s\n' "$1" | awk 'BEGIN { e = sprintf("%c", 27) } { if (NR > 1) printf "\n"; printf "%s%s[K", $0, e }'

   262	# dash_watch <role> <raw> <id> — the viewer loop: live frames every HARNESS_DASH_SEC and on SIGWINCH, then the final
   263	# frame, kept alive and re-rendered on a size change (polled every HARNESS_DASH_IDLE_SEC too) until HUP/INT/TERM/QUIT
   264	# or the ask is removed or replaced. dash_end runs on every exit path.
   265	dash_watch() {
   266	  local role=$1 raw=$2 id=$3
   267	  trap 'dash_end; exit 130' INT TERM
   268	  trap 'dash_end; exit 129' HUP
   269	  trap 'dash_end; exit 131' QUIT
   270	  trap dash_end EXIT
   271	  trap 'DASH_WINCH=1' WINCH

   273	  if hl_alive "$role"; then
   274	    while hl_alive "$role" && ! hl_done "$role" "$id"; do
   275	      DASH_WINCH=0
   276	      dash_paint "$(hl_dash_frame "$role" "$raw")"
   277	      [ "$DASH_WINCH" = 1 ] || dash_nap "${HARNESS_DASH_SEC:-2}"
   278	    done
   279	    sleep 1   # let the runner write exit.json
   280	  fi
   281	  local sz="" now
   282	  while :; do
   283	    DASH_WINCH=0; now=$(dash_size)
   284	    if [ "$now" != "$sz" ]; then
   285	      sz=$now
   286	      dash_paint "$(HARNESS_DASH_FINAL=1 hl_dash_frame "$role" "$raw")"
   287	    fi

   289	    [ "$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" 2>/dev/null)" = "$id" ] || break
   290	    [ "$DASH_WINCH" = 1 ] || dash_nap "${HARNESS_DASH_IDLE_SEC:-1}"
   291	  done
   292	  dash_end

1	#!/bin/bash
2	# Tests for bin/harness-verify. Run: /bin/bash tests/verify.test.sh
3	set -u
4	HERE=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
5	VERIFY="$HERE/../bin/harness-verify"
6	pass=0
7	fail=0
8	
9	ROOT=$(mktemp -d)
10	trap 'rm -rf "$ROOT"' EXIT
11	N=0
12	
13	check() { # check LABEL CONDITION...
14	  local label=$1; shift
15	  if "$@"; then pass=$((pass + 1)); else fail=$((fail + 1)); echo "FAIL [$label]: out=$OUT"; fi
16	}
17	
18	# newrepo -> sets R to a fresh git repo with one commit (cwd stays put)
19	newrepo() {
20	  N=$((N + 1))
21	  R="$ROOT/r$N"
22	  mkdir -p "$R"
23	  ( cd "$R" && git init -q && git config user.email t@t && git config user.name t \
24	      && echo seed > seed.txt && git add seed.txt && git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null commit -q -m seed )
25	}
26	
27	# hv ARGS... -> runs harness-verify inside $R; sets OUT (stdout) and RC
28	hv() { OUT=$(cd "$R" && /bin/bash "$VERIFY" "$@" 2>/dev/null </dev/null); RC=$?; }
29	# hvin JSON ARGS... -> same, with JSON on stdin
30	hvin() { local j=$1; shift; OUT=$(cd "$R" && printf '%s' "$j" | /bin/bash "$VERIFY" "$@" 2>/dev/null); RC=$?; }
31	
32	cfg() { mkdir -p "$R/.claude"; printf '%s' "$1" > "$R/.claude/harness.json"; }
33	lcfg() { mkdir -p "$R/.harness"; printf '%s' "$1" > "$R/.harness/verify.local.json"; }
34	det() { hv detect; printf '%s' "$OUT" | jq -r "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
35	stopjson() { jq -n -c --arg c "$R" '{hook_event_name:"Stop",agent_type:"implementer",cwd:$c,stop_hook_active:false}'; }
36	postjson() { jq -n -c --arg c "$R" --arg t "$1" --arg f "$2" '{hook_event_name:"PostToolUse",agent_type:"implementer",cwd:$c,tool_name:$t,tool_input:{file_path:$f}}'; }
37	not_cmp() { ! cmp -s "$@"; }
38	not_grep() { ! grep "$@"; }
39	not_out_has() { ! printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q -- "$1"; }
40	reason_grep() { printf '%s' "$OUT" | jq -r .reason | grep "$@"; }
41	not_reason_grep() { ! reason_grep "$@"; }
42	result() { jq -r ".$1" "$R/.harness/verify/implementer.json" 2>/dev/null; }
43	
44	# --- detect: explicit config only, no auto-detection ---------------------------------
45	newrepo
46	hv detect
47	check "detect empty rc" [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]
48	check "detect empty format null" [ "$(det .format)" = null ]
49	check "detect empty lint null" [ "$(det .lint)" = null ]
50	check "detect empty test null" [ "$(det .test)" = null ]

54	
55	# project-type files are ignored

57	printf 'fmt:\n\ttrue\nlint:\n\ttrue\ntest:\n\ttrue\n' > "$R/Makefile"

62	check "no autodetect format" [ "$(det .format)" = null ]
63	check "no autodetect lint" [ "$(det .lint)" = null ]
64	check "no autodetect test" [ "$(det .test)" = null ]

66	check "detect autodetect-files: still hints at config" grep -q '.claude/harness.json' <<<"$OUT"

72	check "detect configured: silent stderr" [ -z "$OUT" ]

    41	# is what the watchdog reaps after a SIGKILLed runner

    64	trap on_signal TERM INT HUP
    65	
    66	# pipeline in its own subshell: kill_tree on $pipe reaches claude and awk.
    67	# set -m made it a background process group: on a tty with `stty tostop` a write (or a tty read)

    71	  trap '' TTOU TTIN

    86	# the pipeline's process group, recorded at start (3rd field; readers only use the first two).

    88	# installed and the pipeline exists, so a close racing the start still finds sigflag + a pipe to kill

    93	# leave it behind, and it then reaps the orphaned pipeline's process group) and kills it on
    94	# timeout only while it is still this runner's child

    96	runner_alive() {
    97	  local st
    98	  st=$(ps -o stat= -p "$runner" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')

   102	  ps -ax -o pgid= -o stat= 2>/dev/null | awk -v g="$1" '$1 == g && $2 !~ /^Z/ { n++ } END { print n + 0 }'
   103	}

   105	# <role> <ask-id> " or the awk stage's hrid=<role>:<ask-id>) is touched; TERM, wait up to 3 s, KILL

   107	  local g=$1 i=0

   109	    | awk -v g="$g" -v a="harness-run $role $id " -v b="hrid=$role:$id" \

   114	  return 0

   123	wd=$!
   124	
   125	wait "$pipe" 2>/dev/null
   126	while kill -0 "$pipe" 2>/dev/null; do wait "$pipe" 2>/dev/null || sleep 0.1; done

   128	wait "$wd" 2>/dev/null
   129	
   130	killed=""
   131	[ ! -e "$wdflag" ] || killed=watchdog
   132	[ -n "$killed" ] || [ ! -e "$sigflag" ] || killed=signal
   133	rc=""
   134	[ -f "$rcf" ] && rc=$(cat "$rcf")

   140	tmp=$exitf.tmp.$$

   142	  [inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")] as $e
   143	  | ([$e[] | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "init")] | first) as $init
   144	  | ([$e[] | select(.type == "result")] | last) as $r

   155	     num_turns: ($r.num_turns // null), cost_usd: ($r.total_cost_usd // null),

372	   146	  | ([$e[] | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "permission_denied")] | map(
373	   147	        {tool: (.tool_name // "?"), input: ((.tool_input.command? // .tool_input.file_path? // .message // "") | tostring | split("\n")[0] | .[0:120]),
374	   148	         reason: (.decision_reason // .message // "")})) as $dev

377	   151	        {tool: (.tool_name // "?"), input: ((.tool_input.command? // .tool_input.file_path? // "") | tostring | split("\n")[0] | .[0:120]), reason: ""})))

404	     4	# --- wiki-lint ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
405	     5	# harness wiki-lint [DIR]   mechanical checks over DIR (default docs/wiki); prints

407	     7	cmd_wiki_lint() {

409	     9	  while [ "${#dir}" -gt 1 ] && [ "${dir%/}" != "$dir" ]; do dir=${dir%/}; done

418	    18	    links=$(grep -E '^- \[' "$idx" | sed -n 's/^[^]]*\]( *\([^) ]*\)).*/\1/p')
419	    19	    while IFS= read -r l; do

425	    25	EOF_LINKS

429	    29	    rel=${f#"$dir"/}

454	    54	  done <<EOF_PAGES

466	    66	cmd_metrics() {

468	    68	  local act=0 stale=0 draft=0 sup=0 oth=0

495	    95	    [ ! -f "$top/docs/wiki/index.md" ] || inj=$(LC_ALL=C grep -F '(active,' "$top/docs/wiki/index.md" | wc -c | tr -d ' ')
496	    96	    wiki=$(jq -n -c --argjson a "$act" --argjson s "$stale" --argjson d "$draft" --argjson u "$sup" --argjson o "$oth" \
497	    97	      --argjson il "$idxl" --argjson ib "$inj" '

500	   100	  fi
501	   101	  { [ -f "$JSONL" ] && cat "$JSONL"; true; } | jq -R -s -r --argjson now "$now" --arg since "$since" --argjson json "$json" \
502	   102	    --argjson roles "$(printf '%s\n' $HARNESS_ROLES | jq -R . | jq -s -c .)" --argjson wiki "$wiki" '
503	   103	    def pct($n; $d): if $d == 0 then null else (($n * 1000 / $d) | round) / 10 end;
504	   104	    def median: sort | if length == 0 then null elif length % 2 == 1 then .[(length / 2 | floor)]

506	   106	    def p95: sort | if length == 0 then null else .[((length * 0.95 | ceil) - 1)] end;

509	   109	      | map(. + {t: (try (.ts | fromdateiso8601) catch null)}) | map(select(.t != null));
510	   110	    def abn: .late == true or (.exit != null and .exit != 0 and .exit != 5);
511	   111	    def role_stat($rs):
512	   112	      ($rs | map(select(.late != true))) as $a
513	   113	      | { asks: ($a | length), late: ($rs | map(select(.late == true)) | length),
514	   114	          abnormal: ($rs | map(select(abn)) | length),
515	   115	          abnormal_rate: pct($rs | map(select(abn)) | length; $rs | length),
516	   116	          exit: ($rs | map(if .late == true then "late" else (.exit | if . == null then "?" else tostring end) end)
517	   117	                 | group_by(.) | map({key: .[0], value: length}) | from_entries),
518	   118	          exit5: ($a | map(select(.exit == 5)) | length),
519	   119	          duration_median_s: ($a | map(.dur_s | select(type == "number")) | median),
520	   120	          duration_p95_s: ($a | map(.dur_s | select(type == "number")) | p95),
521	   121	          mean_verify_attempts: ($a | map(.verify_attempts | select(type == "number")) | if length == 0 then null else ((add / length * 10 | round) / 10) end) };
522	   122	    def clear_stat($rs):

524	   124	      | ($a | map(select(.clear == "ok")) | length) as $ok
525	   125	      | ($a | map(select(.clear == "retry")) | length) as $rt
526	   126	      | ($a | map(select(.clear == "respawn")) | length) as $rs2
527	   127	      | { ok: $ok, retry: $rt, respawn: $rs2, none: ($a | map(select(.clear == "none")) | length),
528	   128	          retry_rate: pct($rt; $ok + $rt + $rs2), respawn_rate: pct($rs2; $ok + $rt + $rs2) };
529	   129	    def stat($rs):
530	   130	      { total: role_stat($rs), clear: clear_stat($rs),
531	   131	        roles: ($roles | map(. as $r | {key: $r, value: role_stat($rs | map(select(.agent == $r)))}) | from_entries) }
532	   132	      | .roles.implementer.verify_failure_rate = pct(.roles.implementer.exit5; .roles.implementer.asks)
533	   133	      | .roles.reviewer.fail_rate = pct(.roles.reviewer.exit5; .roles.reviewer.asks)
534	   134	      | .by_runner = ($rs | group_by("\(.agent)/\(.runner // "pane")")
535	   135	          | map({key: "\(.[0].agent)/\(.[0].runner // "pane")",
536	   136	                 value: (role_stat(.) + {cost_usd_sum: (map(.cost_usd | select(type == "number")) | add // 0),

538	   138	                   startup_s_median: (map(select(.late != true) | .startup_s | select(type == "number")) | median)})})
539	   139	          | from_entries);
540	   140	    (rows) as $all
541	   141	    | (if $since == "" then $now - 28 * 86400 else ($since + "T00:00:00Z" | fromdateiso8601) end) as $start
542	   142	    | ($now - $start) as $len

558	   158	          "",

561	   161	          ($roles[] as $r | row("  \($r)"; .current.roles[$r].asks; .prev.roles[$r].asks)),
562	   162	          row("late reports"; .current.total.late; .prev.total.late),
563	   163	          row("abnormal rate (exit not 0/5, late)"; (.current.total.abnormal_rate | pc); (.prev.total.abnormal_rate | pc)),
564	   164	          ($roles[] as $r | row("  \($r)"; (.current.roles[$r].abnormal_rate | pc); (.prev.roles[$r].abnormal_rate | pc))),
565	   165	          row("implementer verify-failure rate"; (.current.roles.implementer.verify_failure_rate | pc); (.prev.roles.implementer.verify_failure_rate | pc)),
566	   166	          row("implementer mean verify attempts"; .current.roles.implementer.mean_verify_attempts; .prev.roles.implementer.mean_verify_attempts),
